insight: A visible SPA-POS reportViewer1 container is only proof that the preview surface exists, not that a report result is ready. In the observed R03 run, the automation logged preview_ready and entered secondary-filter handling before the delayed exact no-data dialog appeared. In R05 it switched from the product reference to the course report before cK_ReQuery had been generated. Shared preview readiness must require an actionable export control, nonzero page/content evidence, or an exact no-data response; multi-stage R03/R11 and R05 reference waits must use the same bounded adaptive activity lease with a hard cap.

Bounded retry only repairs transient Path.replace denial. The observed 2.1.16 R06 failures exhausted about 4.58 seconds of retry while the sibling .tmp was writable, and a Windows reproduction showed that a read-only existing run_state_latest.json deterministically raises WinError 5 on replace. On PermissionError, clear read-only only when the target is an existing regular file lacking the write bit, then retry atomic replace. Preserve bounded failure for ACL denial or long external locks; never hide the error or fall back to direct non-atomic overwrite.

After a partial backfill, regenerate the next manifest from authoritative child summaries and evidence before packaging. Keeping successful rows in the old manifest can create duplicate Drive uploads even when the repair itself is correct. The 2.1.16 summary removed successful 8/4 W01/R14, 8/9 and 8/11 R06, and 8/11 R04 from 2.1.17; the final NonR05 preview must contain only 8/8 R06, 8/10 R06 and 8/11 R03, while R05 remains isolated. Preserve the generic R13-W01-R14 atomic code even when no current R14 gap remains.

When an operator confirms an older instrumented release was never installed, do not require stepping through that release before backfill. Re-audit Drive first, then gate directly on the newest release needed by the current manifest. Here 2.1.14 only added evidence packaging, 2.1.15 added NonR05/R05 isolation, 2.1.16 added transient state-write retry plus exact R13 no-data continuation, and 2.1.17 fixes persistent read-only state targets plus premature multi-stage preview readiness; therefore remaining actionable gaps require 2.1.17 or newer. Verify ProductVersion from file metadata because the windowed executable may print no stdout, then run NonR05 before isolated R05.

When a remaining Drive-gap manifest begins with a known failing task, a correct circuit breaker can prevent every independent later gap from ever running. Split the same verified manifest into an independent NonR05 scope and an isolated R05 diagnostic scope while retaining one full-batch mutex. Run NonR05 first; treat R13, W01 and R14 as one atomic chain. Then run R05 with a one-failure limit so evidence is captured without blocking the other outputs. A real PowerShell preview must prove exact task counts and the absence of cross-scope tasks before release.

Before asking an operator to find a failure-evidence ZIP, compare the child execution timestamps with the release artifact build time and inspect the outer-log schema. The observed R05 children ran at 21:44-21:52, while v2.1.14 was built at 23:18-23:19; their logs also lacked FailureEvidenceBundle, FailureEvidenceError and the CSV EvidenceBundle column. The old run therefore could never have produced the new ZIP. Accept the operator's complete handoff, identify the run as pre-feature, and require a new run after installing the instrumented version instead of repeatedly requesting a nonexistent artifact.

An outer backfill log with task, timestamps and exit code is insufficient to diagnose an application-level failure. Immediately after every nonzero child exit, package time-bounded logs, screenshots, state and Windows runtime evidence into the same backfill folder, write the bundle path into both the task log and summary CSV, and include a manifest with copy/collector errors. Explicitly exclude config, downloads, output and credentials. A fake-child integration loop must prove the ZIP and manifest exist before release.

In a Start-Process based backfill wrapper, ExitCode=1 with an empty ProcessError proves that PowerShell successfully created and waited for the child; it does not identify the application failure. Do not diagnose EXE path or PowerShell argument construction from that evidence. Collect the child's manual_single_task_startup, automation_runtime, action log, run_state and screenshots before choosing among POS preview, export, SaveAs, Drive upload or readiness hypotheses.

A circuit breaker is proven in production by the ordered child summary, not merely by script text. The refreshed 2.1.13 backfill summary contains only failed 2026-08-02 R05 and failed 2026-08-03 R05, with no later manifest rows, demonstrating that the default two-consecutive-failure threshold stopped the batch before R13/W01/R14 and all later dates.

Monthly cumulative POS filenames contain both the month start and report end date. Arbitrary substring matching can falsely treat `課程服務明細表-20260801-20260803-僅新客.xls` as evidence that an end-date 20260801 file exists because 20260801 appears in the first field. Audit R01/R02/R03/R05/R11/R12 by anchoring the second date immediately before the mode suffix and extension. After correcting this matcher, the 2026-08-02 R05 run remained missing and the refreshed Drive gap total stayed at 38.

Outer backfill logs can preserve decisive timing evidence even when the child version does not write inner startup diagnostics. In the observed run, 13 failed children exited in 1.31 to 4.02 minutes, while 20260804_R11 stayed inside Start-Process -Wait for 302.05 minutes and the next child launched immediately after the operator closed the error window. That outlier timing matches a modal windowed traceback blocking process exit, not ordinary adaptive report waiting. Always compare StartedAt/FinishedAt across child logs before attributing a long run to data volume.

A PyInstaller windowed executable has no usable console and can surface an uncaught --run-task exception as a fatal traceback dialog. Every manual task phase, including date parsing, config loading and AutomationRunner execution, must catch exceptions, return a nonzero exit code, and persist a manual_single_task_startup diagnostic with task/date/phase/exception evidence. This lets a PowerShell parent observe failure without requiring the operator to close repeated dialogs.

AutomationRunner previously continued to the next report after an unexpected task exception even when POS reconnect failed, causing every later task to inherit a stale or invalid session. Route unexpected exceptions through the same reconnect/readiness gate as known report failures. Continue only when POS is verifiably ready; otherwise mark every remaining POS output POS_CONNECTION_FAILED and stop touching POS.

A historical backfill can amplify one shared POS failure into many child launches and user-visible error dialogs. Keep the batch mutex, wait for each child exit code, reset the failure count only on success, and stop the manifest after a small configurable number of consecutive failures (default two). R14 remains a same-date R13 to W01 to R14 dependency chain and must stop on either upstream failure.

After a partial backfill, do not rerun the original missing-file manifest. Re-list every task folder, subtract newly uploaded semantic matches, and generate a new manifest containing only current gaps. The 2026-08-11 re-audit reduced 67 missing outputs to 38: 29 were repaired, while the remaining 2026-08-04 R14 gap still requires R13, W01 and R14 for the same run date.

SPA-POS ReportViewer export buttons can be captured while disabled and later remain stale; wait logic must periodically rescan for a fresh enabled export control instead of polling only the initial wrapper.

SAVE_AS_DIALOG_FAILED often means Export to Excel did not actually trigger a Save As dialog, not that SaveAsHandler is broken; verify export format selection and detect Save As appearance before waiting full timeout.

During POS real-machine debugging, every report run should write action JSONL plus UI probe snapshot under logs_dir so failures that happen before normal actions still reveal phase, error, and current control tree.
R07/R08 branch multi-select opens cT_Branch and pb_Branch but UIA may not expose N001-N006 list items; fallback should use keyboard navigation HOME then DOWN SPACE per branch and log each key action.

R05 course-service secondary filter requires clicking other conditions before 二次篩選; when the child form is partly offscreen, maximize or move the report form before interacting, then restore only after the option is set.

R06 branch loop may show no-data warning instead of Save As; automation must detect 注意事項 or 錯誤警告 text like currently no matching residual data, click OK, return NO_REPORT_DATA, and continue next branch or workflow.

SPA-POS UIA wrappers can raise .NET COM errors during set_edit_text, toggle, click, or invoke; prefer real input fallbacks like click_input, type_keys, dynamic rectangle center click, keyboard ENTER or SPACE, and refetch wrappers after state changes.

In this POS WinForms ReportViewer flow, UIA invoke on the view report button can return without starting report generation. Prefer real click_input for the shared view-report step, then keep keyboard fallback for failures.

ReportViewer export readiness is shared by all reports. A disabled export wrapper captured before generation can stay stale, so wait loops must refind the enabled export control on each poll before deciding EXPORT_BUTTON_NOT_READY.
For client demo recovery after regressions, restore the stable checkpoint first, save unstable work as a patch, and apply only minimal shared-flow fixes with regression tests before packaging.

When the user asks to restore the original behavior after a bad checkpoint rollback, use the saved pre-checkpoint patch as the base, then apply only the shared root-cause fixes on top. Do not interpret original behavior as the checkpoint if the checkpoint caused the new regression.

POS ReportViewer can expose the Excel export menu item and accept UIA click calls without opening Save As. The shared export-format flow must verify Save As appears, then retry the visible Excel item with geometry click and Enter fallback before failing.

Action logs showed R06 SaveAs succeeds, while R01/R02 failed before Excel due export click issues, R04 failed after export due no Excel menu, and R03/R05 had disabled toolbar controls. Treat ReportViewer export as a two-stage state machine: first verify export menu or SaveAs after pressing export, then select Excel; if toolbar remains disabled with viewer present, report NO_REPORT_DATA instead of generic automation failure.

POS action logs showed Excel export MenuItem visible and enabled, while repeated UIA and geometry clicks still failed to open Save As. The safer sequence is keyboard-first selection while the popup is active, then legacy click fallback, plus ESC cleanup on failure before the next report starts.
SPA-POS ReportViewer 匯出按鈕可能在 UIA probe 中顯示 enabled=false，但實際報表預覽已出現時仍需要優先鎖定 ReportToolBar 內 name=匯出 的控制項，使用 click_input 與幾何點擊 fallback；不可只等待 enabled=true，否則 R01/R02/R03/R05 會長時間等待或誤判沒有資料。
SPA-POS 的 檢視報表 click_input 可能回傳成功但 POS 實際沒有開始產生報表；按下後必須短時間驗證 ReportViewer 或匯出工具列是否出現，若無反應要立刻改用鍵盤 Enter/其他點擊重試，不可直接進入數分鐘等待匯出啟用。
POSReportBot 的 {month_start} 不能用今天所在月份計算；日報的結束日是昨天，因此月初也必須用昨天所在月份的 1 號。否則每月 1 日會產生 6/1~5/31 這種起日晚於迄日的錯誤區間。
POSReportBot 匯出流程若已找到並點擊 Excel 匯出格式，但 Windows 另存新檔視窗沒有在短時間出現，應以 EXPORT_SAVE_AS_DIALOG_NOT_OPENED 快速失敗並記錄 wait_result，不要繼續用鍵盤與重複點擊 fallback 長時間重試；否則使用者會以為 GUI 或 POS 當機。

SPA-POS button controls may be partially outside the visible POS window. R01 action log showed 檢視報表 rect 997,116,1058,149, so pywinauto click_input can log success while hitting the offscreen center and POS does nothing. Verify real state change and retry by clicking the visible intersection of the control rectangle and POS window rectangle, not hard-coded coordinates.

POSReportBot currently runs execute_enabled_reports synchronously from the GUI action path. Long POS waits can make the GUI look unresponsive even when automation is still running. Long waits need action-log heartbeats now, and the larger architecture should move automation to a worker thread with progress events.

POSReportBot phase architecture now separates automation execution into app.automation_runner.AutomationRunner and runs GUI-triggered report execution through a QThread worker. Keep execute_enabled_reports as a synchronous test seam, while dashboard button starts background execution and receives progress/final summary events.

R01 probe after report preview contained 10703 controls: required controls were B_RunReport depth 5, ReportToolBar depth 6, and 匯出 depth 8, while most report table data was depth 12. After report generation, automation and default UI probe should scan only to depth 9 with control-count limits to avoid freezing on large report grids.

R01 logs showed the report preview was visible but automation stayed in click_view_report after keyboard_enter and never entered export_report_to_excel. View-report confirmation must use a short bounded wait only; if not confirmed, continue into the export-button wait phase where heartbeat logs and timeout handling exist, instead of blocking in ReportViewer detection.

R01 logs showed B_RunReport rect 1075,194,1136,227, fully outside a 1024-wide POS viewport. Automation must make the report child window/control visible before clicking view report and must skip geometry clicks when the control has no visible intersection with the POS window. Otherwise pywinauto logs clicks against offscreen coordinates and export never enables.

POSReportBot should not synchronously deep-scan ReportViewer after clicking 檢視報表. Real POS ReportViewer may expose huge UIA trees and block before export phase. Click_view_report should fire and advance; export phase should do bounded ReportToolBar/匯出 search.

POSReportBot should not hard-fail after selecting Excel just because a pre-check cannot see the Windows Save As dialog. Real POS can display 另存新檔 while pywinauto Desktop title detection misses or blocks. After selecting Excel, hand off to WindowsSaveAsHandler to wait, type full path, click save, and report SAVE_AS_DIALOG_FAILED if needed.

POSReportBot should not accept a visible ReportViewer export control when the toolbar looks empty and the export control is disabled. That path caused R09 to click a disabled 匯出 and then fail with EXPORT_FORMAT_NOT_FOUND. Skip disabled empty toolbar export and let the flow fail as unconfirmed/not ready instead.

When a report fails during export format selection or other ReportAutomationError paths, POSReportBot must close the active report child window. R09 failure left a customer-source report window behind and the next R10 task failed during open_report_screen with a .NET automation error.

For POSReportBot R07/R08 appointment branch multi-select, visible success can be false if the script sends SPACE. Real POS branch list rows require ENTER to toggle each branch. Logs must show branch:<label>:keyboard_enter or geometry_enter, not keyboard_space, before treating multi-select as complete.

R07/R08 appointment branch multi-select became very slow because POSReportBot checked each missing branch via expensive UI/Desktop scans before opening the visible branch list. Open the branch picker quickly first, then use row geometry plus ENTER before falling back to generic control scans.

R07/R08 分館多選在最新 POS UI probe 會 expose _cPopWinGrid；分館列名稱不含 N001-N006，只能看到 Y/N 資料列 0-6。不可用 cT_Branch anchor 下方盲點座標就判定成功；要點 _cPopWinGrid 的 Y/N 資料列 1-6 中心並送 Enter，或在找不到 popup/grid 時回報 BRANCH_CONTROL_NOT_FOUND，避免匯出未勾分館的假成功報表。

R07/R08 預約紀錄查詢統計表的分館多選有 cT_Branch Edit 與 pb_Branch Pane；實機失敗 log 只出現 click:分館多選 但沒有 _cPopWinGrid，手動成功 UI probe 顯示清單從 pb_Branch 右側按鈕展開。自動化必須優先點 pb_Branch，並等到 _cPopWinGrid 出現才算分館 panel 已開；不要點 cT_Branch 文字框後就假設 panel opened。
R07/R08 的 _cPopWinGrid 分館清單中，點 Y/N 資料列本身會切換勾選狀態；若點完再送 Enter，會把同一列再次切換，造成分館勾選後又被取消。popup grid 幾何路徑應只 click Y/N 資料列 1-6 一次，不送 Enter；只有純鍵盤 fallback 才送 Enter。

R09/R10 客戶來源與產值統計表在選 Excel 並完成 SaveAs 後，POS 仍可能顯示「正在匯出／請稍候」modal。SaveAsHandler 回傳成功只代表另存視窗已處理與檔案初步驗證完成，不代表 POS 匯出流程已結束；必須等待匯出進度視窗消失後才可關閉報表或進下一個任務。若進度逾時，回報 EXPORT_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT 並嘗試按「取消」釋放 POS，避免後續任務被 modal 卡住。
POS/WinForms 長時間匯出可能讓視窗無回應；報表層只負責每 5 秒健康檢查並丟 POS_NOT_RESPONDING/EXPORT_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT，runner 層才負責有限次數 taskkill、重新啟動、重新登入與重跑同一個未完成任務，避免單一流程無限等待或直接讓整輪中斷。
POS 自動重啟後若需要自動登入，密碼不可寫入 YAML/JSON/log/test snapshot；設定檔只保存 credential_keyring_service 和帳號，密碼必須由 GUI/工具寫入 Windows Credential Manager/keyring，runner 從 keyring 讀取後才執行登入。
SPA-POS ReportViewer 預覽已產生資料時，工具列上的列印/下一頁/匯出等控制項仍可能被 UIA 標成 disabled；不能只用 disabled toolbar count 判斷報表空白。需先看頁數或 DataItem/Text 資料列證據，等待匯出也要優先淺層掃描工具列，避免深掃第 9 層導致 R09 卡數分鐘。
POS/SMTP/Drive 憑證若使用 keyring，keyring 必須存在於正式 pyproject dependencies 與 PyInstaller hiddenimports；只放在 template 或文件會讓安裝檔執行時出現 No module named keyring，導致 Windows Credential Manager 儲存入口不可用。
SPA-POS 重啟後或使用者手動開啟時可能停在帳號登入畫面；runner 初始 connect 後若偵測到帳號/密碼/登入控制項，必須先輸入登入資訊並等待登入畫面消失，再建立 automator 跑 R09/R01 等報表，否則會停在登入畫面。
POS 憑證儲存依賴 keyring 時，安裝檔或舊環境可能缺 keyring；GUI 必須提供本次執行記憶體密碼欄位作 fallback，且不得寫入 YAML/JSON/log。runner 讀取順序應為 GUI transient secret 優先，再 fallback keyring。
手動執行與排程都必須先建立 POS session：先連線既有 POS，連不到就啟動 POS，再等待登入/主畫面；若是登入畫面就登入，若已登入就直接跑 build_dry_run_plan 產生的使用者啟用任務。此流程不可寫死 R09 或任何單一報表。
Windows 另存新檔已出現時，SaveAsHandler 若在等待迴圈反覆掃描 Desktop.windows()/全桌面快照，會讓 UIA 變很慢；正常等待應快速 poll title，只有逾時診斷才收集桌面視窗快照。
pywinauto wrapper 的 getattr(window, "login_pos") 可能被解讀成查找名為 login_pos 的 GUI 元件並拋出錯誤；檢查自訂 hook 或 wrapper 方法時必須用 safe getattr 捕捉例外，否則背景自動化會出現 Neither GUI element nor wrapper method found。

POSReportBot report tasks with upload_enabled true must require local SaveAs success plus Google Drive upload success before runner marks the task complete; missing folder ID is a task failure, not a warning.

POSReportBot pywinauto wrapper getattr for optional methods can trigger UI element lookup and raise Neither GUI element nor wrapper method. Guard getattr calls and fall back to explicit control scanning for login.
POSReportBot SaveAs wait loops should poll dialog title directly and only collect full Desktop window records on timeout; repeated desktop scans made SaveAs phases feel hung on POS hosts.

POSReportBot shared export wait for all reports must not poll by scanning full report preview contents. Keep recurring checks to toolbar/dialog-level controls; reserve deeper child scans for exceptional fallback such as R06 no-data SaveAs timeout handling.

POSReportBot Drive upload success must require a non-empty Google Drive file id. A successful API response without id is not enough evidence, and the runner must fail with DRIVE_FILE_ID_MISSING instead of marking the report complete.

POSReportBot GUI Drive upload tests must parse folder URLs through parse_drive_folder_id before upload. The planner already parses URLs, but direct GUI test paths can regress if they pass raw Google Drive URLs to the uploader.

When View Report click raises CONTROL_NOT_CLICKABLE, POSReportBot should continue only after confirming a newly enabled export/report response or after actually sending a fallback click. Otherwise stop with VIEW_REPORT_CLICK_UNCONFIRMED to avoid exporting stale report viewers.

Before refactoring POSReportBot report automation state or export strategy, add golden action contract tests for representative flows. R01, R05, R06, R07, and R09 should lock high-level action order while allowing internal helper and fallback details to change.

POSReportBot RunStateStore Stage B should first persist evidence for task started, file saved, uploaded with drive_file_id, completed, and failed phases without changing execution or skipping behavior. Resume and dedupe should be a later explicit step after POS-host validation.

POSReportBot should support a global Google Drive upload switch. During POS-host report download debugging, keep google_drive.upload_enabled false so RPA can validate report preview, export, and SaveAs without entering Drive upload or OAuth flows.

When POSReportBot appears stuck, action logs must write wait_start before any potentially slow pre-check, especially export enable and SaveAs handling. Otherwise logs show multi-minute blank gaps and make it impossible to distinguish POS generation time from slow UI scans or SaveAs waiting.

SPA-POS ClickOnce login controls can become stale and raise invalid window handle errors; when the account field already has focus, use keyboard fallback only after stale-handle failure: clear account, type account, Tab, clear password, type password, Enter, then reconnect instead of waiting on the old handle.

For R04 and R05 secondary filter, do not globally scan for 二次篩選 before opening 其他條件 because the checkbox is hidden until L_OtherWhere or L_OtherQuery is clicked; prefer active report form bounded child search by automation_id, then fallback.

Windows Save As detection can be slow when relying on Desktop.window(title_re).exists; enumerate desktop windows first and match title contains 另存新檔 so the handler can react as soon as the dialog is visible.

POSReportBot 的 ReportWindowAutomator 目前混合 UI 查找、報表流程狀態、POS health check、匯出等待、另存與診斷輸出；實機 logs 顯示 wait_start:匯出啟用 後可被單次 UI 查找或 health check 卡到 120 秒。後續修復應先切出 Session/Login、ReportFormInteractor、ExportStateMachine、HealthMonitor 或 ProbePolicy，並以 action log contract tests 保護 R01-R12 共用流程。

SPA-POS login page invalid window handle must not fall back to the same login wrapper edit or button controls. On Windows, foreground the login window, type username, tab, password, enter by keyboard; if still on login screen, report POS_LOGIN_FAILED to avoid stale handle operations or accidental POS shutdown.

SPA-POS ReportViewer export toolbar and export button may be deeper than level 5. Bounded export search should stay inside report-toolbar-related subtrees, avoid large report grids or tables, and allow depth at least 9.

After view report, waiting for export must not let expensive UI search block health/action logs. A real R01 log showed wait_start export then no health log for about 120 seconds. Later polling should run POS responsiveness checks before bounded export search.

SPA-POS login detection can hit stale pywinauto wrappers and raise invalid window handle before typing credentials. When login state is uncertain, avoid wrapper magic lookup and prefer focusing a fresh window then keyboard username TAB password ENTER.

After clicking report toolbar export, keyboard fallback such as ALT DOWN ENTER must only count as selecting Excel if SaveAs is positively observed. Unknown or timed-out SaveAs state must fail fast instead of continuing into a long SaveAs timeout.

Failure diagnostics after a report preview should reuse bounded post-report controls instead of all_controls. Deep UI probes after preview can stall POSReportBot and make failures appear as application hangs.

Once a SPA-POS report preview is visible, report automation should search bounded toolbar/menu candidates and prune report grid/table subtrees. Scanning full ReportViewer content makes R01-R06 waits explode from seconds to minutes.

SPA-POS export wait must not call pywinauto Desktop UIA/window enumeration on every poll. R04 logs showed 120s gaps before each fallback because global UIA/Desktop scans blocked the automation thread; use Win32 top-level handle checks and cache/throttle desktop viewer lookup.

After one full report render wait, retrying 檢視報表 must use a capped retry timeout instead of reusing the full 300s or 600s report max_wait_seconds. Otherwise a single failed export detection doubles or triples perceived hang time.

POSReportBot formal failure notification should use GmailOAuthSender with the shared GoogleOAuthService token, matching GUI Gmail test and avoiding a separate SMTP/keyring password path. Email UI labels may still mention SMTP but runner notification now routes through Gmail API.

POSReportBot evidence on 2026-06-04 showed R06 failure probes containing visible Excel menu items while automation still raised EXPORT_FORMAT_NOT_FOUND. Root cause: after report preview on Windows, export format lookup checked desktop popup menus but skipped the POS/report-viewer control tree. Always search the bounded report-viewer/window scope as well as native popup menus before declaring Excel missing.

POSReportBot logs on 2026-06-04 showed failure probe writing taking 3-6 minutes for R06. Diagnostic and runtime probes must use bounded depth and record limits; full descendants or full report-table scans during failure handling make the app look hung and delay the next task.

For POSReportBot, run_state must be finalized before Gmail or other notification work. If notification or post-processing blocks after failures, leaving run_state as running confuses users and hides which task was last active.

POSReportBot R01 evidence on 2026-06-04 stopped immediately after wait_start for the SaveAs dialog and never logged wait_result or filename entry. SaveAs waits must first use fast top-level Win32 window detection and bounded native dialog heuristics, then log branch timings; slow pywinauto enumeration can make the app look hung before filename entry starts.

On installed Windows POSReportBot, saving settings to C:\ProgramData\POSReportBot\config\app.yaml can fail with PermissionError for non-admin users. GUI settings save must fall back to a per-user LOCALAPPDATA config path and future startup should prefer that saved user config.
For this project phase, the user states all report tasks are daily. Scheduler UI and task creation should center on daily triggers rather than weekly options.

Windows Task Scheduler command for POSReportBot must invoke the real enabled-report runner, not dry-run. The scheduled task should read the saved GUI config and execute the reports selected by the user.

POS Save As dialog may be visible while pywinauto desktop or control-tree scanning blocks before filename entry. Prefer foreground or title win32 handle detection, then clipboard full-path paste and Enter; keep deep UI probing out of the save critical path.

Creating the Windows Task Scheduler entry from POSReportBot can fail with schtasks access denied under a normal user token. The GUI needs an explicit save schedule action and should retry task creation through UAC elevation when access is denied.

SPA-POS ReportViewer export control may be found by UIA with enabled=false after preview is visible. Center or dropdown geometry clicks can leave the Excel menu closed. Try the left/icon side of the export rectangle and only advance after Excel item or SaveAs dialog is observed.

For SPA-POS report branch selectors, target value 所有分店 may already be selected before automation interacts with the combo box. Treat that state as success and log selector candidates before failing, otherwise R10-like reports can stop unnecessarily.

After SPA-POS report preview is visible, export wait must not build a full control-tree list before selecting the ReportViewer toolbar export button. Search active report toolbar lazily and stop as soon as a visible export candidate is found; otherwise large report previews can make R01 appear hung after preview.

Windows SaveAs waiting should first poll foreground and top-level window handles for the dialog title and log progress. Delay pywinauto Desktop enumeration because Desktop scans can block while POS is busy and make the app look frozen before filename entry.

The workaround that accepts a UIA-disabled export control must apply only to ReportViewer toolbar export controls. A disabled direct form export control means the report is not ready and should trigger view-report retry or failure, not export.

POSReportBot had keyboard clipboard entry for SaveAs only after a dialog wrapper was found. R01 logs showed the hang happened before that, at Desktop scan. SaveAs keyboard blind-fill must run after fast foreground/top-level handle checks fail and before any pywinauto Desktop enumeration in the normal download path.

POSReportBot R05 can fail after r05_course_initial_report_viewed with OTHER_CONDITION_NOT_FOUND because the course report form/control wrappers may be stale after ReportViewer preview, and the WinForms Static L_OtherQuery click/click_input may log a click without expanding 二次篩選. POSReportBot can surface UNEXPECTED_RUNNER_ERROR when an original report automation failure enters cleanup, then close_report_viewer or control identity access raises pywinauto/COM event errors such as -2147220991. Error handlers must use safe close wrappers and control identity must use safe attribute access so the original ReportAutomationError and diagnostic probe are preserved instead of being masked by runner-level errors.

SPA-POS SaveAs may appear as #32770 with filename Edit control id 1001 and Save button id 1. If automation falls back to raw keyboard typing too early, full paths can be truncated and leave a path error dialog that affects the next report. Prefer native Win32 control-id set and click, delay blind fallback, and require clipboard paste for blind keyboard.

When a POS report SaveAs fails after Excel selection, the SaveAs or path-error modal can remain open. The next report may then operate on stale or invisible forms and fail unrelated controls such as R12 sales allocation. Preserve the failure probe first, then dismiss transient UI and close report windows safely before continuing.

POSReportBot SaveAs validation is the success boundary. After a file is validated, export-progress waits and report-window close must be best-effort; COM/UIA cleanup errors such as -2147220991 should be logged and followed by reconnecting the POS wrapper before the next task, not by changing the saved report to failure.

R06 logs showed Excel was clicked and later failure probes contained the Save As #32770 dialog with filename control 1001 and save button 1, but SaveAsHandler had stopped fast detection after 12 seconds and entered blind keyboard fallback. 2026-06-06 R05/R06 failed logs showed click export format Excel followed by 60s SaveAs wait and blind fallback failure, while failed UI probes still showed the Excel menu item visible and no SaveAs dialog. 2026-06-06 later R05/R06 logs showed repeated EXPORT_FORMAT_NOT_FOUND after click export format Excel because the code treated Excel menu_still_visible after geometry click as proof that export did not start. If R06 has no data, let SaveAs/no-data handling classify it after export activation.

When POS export format is clicked but Save As never appears, do not classify only as blind keyboard fallback failure. Capture foreground/top-level/child window snapshots during SaveAs wait to distinguish missed Excel click, POS export progress, no-data warning, hidden modal, or title/handle mismatch. Keep snapshots lightweight to avoid reintroducing slow Desktop scans.

For POS ReportViewer export, clicking the Excel menu item must not be treated as success unless SaveAs or the POS export progress dialog appears, especially after R05 second view or R06 branch changes. If no observed response, retry export selection instead of handing off to SaveAsHandler for a 60s wait.

R05 may fail after product reference preview because opening the second course report can partially create the target child window and then pywinauto raises a COM or .NET stale wrapper error. After menu_select errors, re-probe for the target report form and date fields before falling back to menu clicks; if full UI diagnostics fail, write a minimal failure diagnostic file.

SPA-POS top-level main window title may include the active report in brackets, such as SPA-POS ... [課程服務明細表]. Never treat controls whose title contains SPA-POS or whose handle equals the root POS window as report child windows to close; cancel 結束程式確認 with 否 if it appears.

Latest R05 logs reach final Course Service Report export; failure is before Excel or SaveAs because export MenuItem click_input and geometry attempts log success but no Excel/xls/SaveAs controls appear. Treat EXPORT_FORMAT_NOT_FOUND here as export menu activation failure. Prefer export-specific expand or invoke fallback with observed menu/SaveAs verification; avoid global click strategy changes that can regress other POS controls.

R05 is less stable when the course-service report is viewed once before opening Other Conditions and checked again; keep product reference preview open, then open course report, set branch/date/options, open Other Conditions, check secondary filter, and only then click View Report once before export.

R06 branch iteration should not reuse the same residual-points report window for multiple branches. Open a fresh report screen for each N001-N006 branch, verify selected branch, export and save, then close the child report window before the next branch to avoid stale toolbar or wrong-branch exports.

R05 simplified workflow: after the product sales reference report is viewed and kept open, open Course Service Detail, set branch/date/options, open Other Conditions, check 二次篩選, then click View Report only once before export. Avoid the old course initial preview then requery then second preview sequence because it destabilizes export state.

R06 simplified workflow: do not reuse one residual report window for multiple branches. For each N001-N006 branch, open the residual report window fresh, select and verify that branch, view/export/save, close the child report window, then proceed to the next branch.

R06 branch no-data is not automation instability: when POS reports currently no matching residual data and automation dismisses the warning, runner should mark that output skipped/no_report_data instead of failed/partial_failed; otherwise a valid empty branch makes a successful run look unstable.

R06 branch NO_REPORT_DATA, especially N006 忠孝預防醫學3樓 when POS says 目前並無符合的療程殘值資料, is an expected no-data outcome, not an automation failure. Runner must mark it as skipped/no_report_data, avoid upload, avoid failure notification, and keep the overall run successful when there are no real failures.

R13 沙貨耗材領用查詢表 is under 庫存管理 > 相關報表, not 統計報表. Report configs need menu_path support; default path remains 統計報表->report_menu_text for R01-R12. Use pywinauto menu_select with the full nested path and keep export and SaveAs shared flow unchanged.
GUI report entry probe must open each enabled report root menu from menu_path, such as 統計報表 and 庫存管理. Opening only 統計報表 makes R13 look missing even when the POS menu exists.

R13 沙貨耗材領用查詢表 is not under 統計報表. It must open through 庫存管理 > 相關報表 > 沙貨耗材領用查詢表 using a full menu_path, then select 所有分店, date range {month_start} to {yesterday}, check 顯示課程耗用, view report, export Excel, SaveAs.

Do not assume every POS report is under 統計報表. ReportConfig supports menu_path for non-statistics reports; automation should default to 統計報表 only when menu_path is empty. GUI probes and report entry validation must include non-statistics roots such as 庫存管理.

When POSReportBot adds a new built-in report such as R13, existing installed user configs under LOCALAPPDATA/ProgramData and old companion reports.template.yaml files may still contain only R01-R12. GUI report rows and run_state are generated from config.reports, so the UI will have no R13 control unless load_project_config merges missing report IDs and drive targets from the current bundled config_templates, with user-edited existing reports taking precedence. Prefer bundled/current templates over stale installed companion templates.

SPA-POS is ClickOnce-installed. A deep path like C:\Users\...\AppData\Local\Apps\2.0\...\SPA1.exe is a cache path and can disappear after POS updates, causing startup to fail before any report with [WinError 2]. Do not hardcode machine-specific ClickOnce exe paths in defaults. Resolve POS launch at runtime: existing configured path first, Start Menu/Desktop .appref-ms entries next, then latest LOCALAPPDATA Apps\2.0 SPA1.exe fallback. Keep failure diagnostics listing configured path and searched roots.

ClickOnce .appref-ms shortcuts may be installed under the all-users Start Menu at %ProgramData%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs, not only the current user Start Menu or Desktop. POS launcher resolution should include ProgramData apprefs before falling back to deep Apps\2.0 SPA1.exe cache paths.

When SPA-POS ClickOnce exposes both a vendor Start Menu appref and a Desktop appref, prefer the Start Menu appref because it is the canonical installed application shortcut. Desktop apprefs may be duplicate user shortcuts and should not win only because their modified time is newer.

For SPA-POS ClickOnce appref resolution, prefer all Start Menu apprefs, including current-user and ProgramData all-users Start Menu locations, before Desktop apprefs. Desktop apprefs are valid backup shortcuts but should not beat canonical Start Menu application references because of newer modified time.

A pywinauto/UIA/COM exception such as -2146233083 can escape report automation as a non-ReportAutomationError when cleanup or stale controls fail. AutomationRunner must handle broad exceptions inside the per-output loop, mark only the active output failed, rebuild/reconnect the automator if possible, then continue remaining outputs. The outer runner exception handler should not be the first line of defense for task-scoped failures.

Report automation cleanup after a task error must be best-effort. If dismissing exit confirmation or sending cleanup ESC hits stale UIA controls, append a skip_cleanup action and continue building the original failure diagnostic; otherwise the cleanup exception can erase the real report failure and leave no screenshot JSON.

R09 and R10 share 客戶來源與產值統計表. When pywinauto menu_select for 統計報表->客戶來源與產值統計表 fails with UIA/COM errors, the submenu leaf may already be visible. Recovery should first click the leaf report menu item and verify date inputs; only if no inputs appear should it ESC and fall back to root->leaf clicking. Avoid changing normal menu_select-success path.

R13 menu leaf remains 沙貨耗材領用查詢表, but the opened POS report Dialog title is 沙貨耗品領用查詢報表 and the query pane title may be 沙貨耗品領用報表. Keep config menu_path unchanged and add report title aliases so _find_report_form can see cT_QueryBdate/cT_QueryEdate. Probe also shows checkbox 顯示課程耗用 has automation id cK_ShowClassTake.

When changing POSReportBot shipped defaults, updating config_templates alone is insufficient because installed app.yaml may already exist and installer keeps user config. Add loader migration that fills only empty or legacy built-in values while preserving user edits.

For POSReportBot GUI builds, hide the black console window by using PyInstaller windowed mode and spec console=False. Tests should assert --windowed and console=False so packaging does not regress to console mode.

User-facing report names may contain separators such as 商品/課程服務明細表, but output_filename must not contain slash because Windows treats it as a path separator and SaveAs will target the wrong path. Use a safe equivalent such as 商品課程服務明細表.

POSReportBot daily folders are resolved in the runtime path layer from existing base directories. Date scope downloads logs screenshots and run state with YYYYMMDD. Keep Google OAuth token storage outside the date scoped state folder so users do not reauthorize every day.

For POSReportBot checkpoint requests, first commit the validated feature state, then fast forward main to that commit, delete the merged feature branch, and tag main HEAD. Verify status shows only main and no staged or unstaged changes before reporting checkpoint complete.

For POSReportBot, a checkpoint/git hygiene review is not the same as a full RPA code review. When the user asks whether a checkpoint was fully reviewed, report both separately: subagent checkpoint review, full local/subagent code review, tests, and remaining real POS validation gap.

POSReportBot can download every report but skip Google Drive when each output has upload_enabled and folder IDs while the global google_drive.upload_enabled flag is false. Evidence is run_state status completed with drive_file_id null for all outputs and no upload events. Add preflight failure for configured uploads when global Drive is disabled, and migrate built-in configs toward Drive enabled when targets exist.

summary: Do not treat a SPA-POS window title or 系統 menu alone as a ready POS main screen. Evidence from R13 showed visible text 稍候程式將自動關閉 and only 系統 menu, so opening 庫存管理 failed with REPORT_ROOT_MENU_NOT_FOUND. Runner must wait for required report root menus such as 統計報表 or 庫存管理 before starting any report.

For POSReportBot, do not treat not detecting the login screen as successful login. During UIA stale or transition states the login window can be unreadable with zero visible controls, which previously advanced to the report ready gate and failed with missing root menus such as 庫存管理. Keyboard, direct, and generic login paths must wait until a real POS main menu such as 統計報表 is visible, and preparation-stage failures need their own diagnostic JSON because report action logs are not created yet.

insight: POSReportBot login readiness must first inspect the current window for normalized main-menu text, then reconnect. Otherwise real POS can be logged in while a transient reconnect failure or decorated UIA menu text such as menu hotkeys makes the runner report POS_LOGIN_FAILED. Preparation diagnostics should include visible control names, and report workflows should not be changed for this preparation-stage failure.

When POSReportBot reconnects after a keyboard login attempt, the returned window may already be the logged-in SPA-POS homepage. Always check normalized main-menu visibility before sending any login keystrokes again, or credentials can be typed into the homepage and the run appears stuck. Prefer resolving the connected POS window by title_re wrapper before using top_window so runner and UI probe inspect the same window.

ClickOnce POS launch can transition from an SPA-POS splash window to a login dialog whose title does not contain SPA-POS. POSReportBot window connection must include login title fallbacks such as 帳號登入 and SPA資訊. When login Edit controls are readable, fill them directly by labels before keyboard fallback; blind keyboard login can skip the account field and cause password error.

SPA-POS login Edit controls may be exposed by UIA in an order that differs from the visual account/password rows. Map 帳號 and 密碼 fields by label rectangle and same-row Edit position first; if only some labels match, preserve those mappings and fill only missing fields. Falling back wholesale to child order can swap account and password.

pywinauto UIA can expose adjacent label text on Edit controls, such as account and password fields named 帳號 or 密碼. POS login must first map enabled Edit controls by normalized own name, then use non-Edit label row matching, and only then fallback. Keyboard fallback must focus the mapped account Edit instead of raw first Edit order, or account and password can be reversed.

After POS/UIA stale automation recovery, reconnecting to SPA-POS must not directly rebuild the report automator from whatever window is returned. The reconnect path must run login readiness and required main-menu readiness again, because title fallback can attach to login, info, or splash windows before the POS home screen is ready.

POSReportBot R03 is not a single final-state options report. It must first run product sales with new-customer checked, wait for preview, then uncheck new-customer, open other conditions, check secondary filter, run preview again, and only then export. YAML options alone cannot express this ordering; report_automation needs an explicit R03 branch.

When R04 is reserved as an empty report number, disabling the YAML row is not enough. Loader normalization must force placeholder state, and planner, Drive target rows, and GUI enable-all behavior must skip non-executable placeholder reports so old installed configs cannot re-enable R04 output.

POSReportBot report filenames should use {start}, {end}, {today}, and {yesterday} for 8-digit YYYYMMDD dates. The *_yymmdd tokens intentionally produce short YYMMDD dates and should only remain for legacy compatibility or tests that exercise migration. Do not change the short formatter globally; update templates and legacy filename migration instead.

POSReportBot release version has four synchronized sources: pyproject.toml project.version, pyproject.template.toml project.version, src/pos_report_bot/__init__.py __version__, and installer/POSReportBot.iss MyAppVersion. Keep tests/unit/test_version.py updated so installer/runtime/package versions cannot drift.

Full pytest can create repo-local Windows-style ProgramData log artifacts on the Linux development machine; before release commit or tag, run git status and remove generated C:\ProgramData\POSReportBot artifacts so runtime logs are not committed.

Latest user-requested naming makes R02, R03, and R12 able to resolve to the same local filename for the same date range; release review must treat this as an explicit accepted product risk or change naming before tagging, because SaveAs rename-unique may create suffixes.

R14 is an offline Excel transformation from R13 raw .xls to demand planning .xlsx. Runner, CLI single-task, and GUI probe paths must classify handler r14_inventory_demand_planning as local so it does not connect to SPA-POS or search POS menus.

R14 output date is based on the R13 raw query end date, not the R13 download date. The transformer must read the raw file period and reject stale raw files whose end date differs from the planned R14 output end date.

R14 templates may already have future month columns on branch sheets but not on Summary. When adding Summary month groups, copy the previous month group, unmerge intersecting header cells, and write Actual values directly from parsed usage totals so output content is testable without relying on Excel recalculation.

For R14, local dev validation must actually generate the demand planning .xlsx from the provided R13 raw .xls into tests/R14_TEST and read the workbook back to verify sheets, query end date, usage row count, and Actual values. Unit tests alone are not enough for user acceptance.

R14 cannot only copy values/formulas when adding a new month. The workbook template uses Excel outline metadata: Summary month total columns are visible collapsed markers and their branch detail columns are hidden outline groups; branch sheets must show Actual months through the R13 report month and keep future months hidden as an outline group.

R13 stock usage raw data is cumulative for the month-to-date period. R14 領用表 must replace all existing rows for the same YYYY/MM before writing the latest raw rows; appending or reusing cleared rows can leave stale duplicate month data.

When R14 inserts new month columns, header values are not enough. Merged-cell ranges and column dimension metadata in the right-side header tail must be captured before insertion and restored shifted by the inserted width, otherwise labels like annual total, safety stock, reserved stock, in-transit, and notes keep old merge/hidden positions.

R14 branch-sheet month visibility should only advance columns for the R13 report year. Expanding every Actual month less than the report date accidentally unhides historical template columns from earlier years.

R14 Summary month insertion requires more than header/hidden metadata shifts. Branch sheet Forecast SUMIF formulas that reference Summary columns must be shifted when their referenced Summary columns are at or after the insertion point; Summary Forecast total formulas must be rebuilt to sum the current Forecast branch columns, not stale Actual/tail columns.

R14 template has five branch sheets but Summary Forecast group has no separate 忠孝健康7樓 Forecast column. The existing template maps 忠孝健康7樓 forecast formulas to the 忠孝7樓 Summary Forecast column. Do not add a new Summary column unless the user confirms this business rule should change.
When global Google Drive upload is disabled, workflows must not fail preflight because upload_enabled is true on report templates. Treat local file validation as success and simply skip upload.
R14 should resolve R13 rawdata by planned R13 output filename first, then only fallback to rawdata glob with date validation. Pure mtime sorting can choose a newer but wrong demand-planning file.
R13 is a POS-exported xls, but R14 is generated by openpyxl from an xlsx template. Do not rename R14 to .xls unless implementing true BIFF conversion; openpyxl cannot write real xls files.

R14 is a local Excel transform and cannot rely on test fixtures existing on the POS host. The installer needs to deploy a production xlsx template, while GUI settings can point to another template when needed.

POS may be logged in while the top window only exposes menuStrip1 and a login-complete text at the first control level. Readiness checks must scan limited child depth to find root MenuItems such as inventory management before failing POS preparation.

Saved user app config can lack r14_transform or keep empty template search settings after upgrades. Loader must merge R14 transform defaults from templates so installed hosts can find the shipped workbook template.
A saved R13 filename using today_mmdd without rawdata can survive app upgrades and break R14 rawdata lookup. Treat old demand-planning xls names as legacy and migrate to end_mmdd rawdata naming.
POS may be fully logged in while root menus are nested under menuStrip1, so readiness checks must scan a bounded descendant depth instead of only direct children before declaring POS not ready.
Older saved app.yaml files may not contain r14_transform defaults, so R14 template/raw lookup defaults must be merged during config load and packaged template dirs must be fallback candidates.
Do not auto-enable google_drive.upload_enabled during config migration just because folder targets exist; a saved false is user intent and local-only report runs must remain valid.

Unsigned PyInstaller and Inno POSReportBot artifacts can be blocked by Windows Defender or Smart App Control, especially with UPX compression or installer-time hidden scheduler creation. Release builds should disable UPX, keep one-folder packaging, sign the app and installer with timestamp, avoid installer hidden persistence, and ship a recovery SOP.

Windows Task Scheduler actions that target python.exe or pythonw.exe need -m pos_report_bot before app CLI args; frozen POSReportBot.exe can use CLI args directly. Without the module flag the task can exit before app logging starts.

After a POS report failure or long export flow, reusing the same UIA automator for later reports is unsafe. A stale wrapper can make later tasks look like branch or menu configuration failures even when the root cause was the first failed report.

R14 completion report email needs its own recipients, subject template, and body settings. Reusing the global failure-notification EmailSettings makes business report recipients follow ops failure recipients and creates incorrect outgoing mail.

When building POSReportBot from POSReportBot.spec, do not pass PyInstaller makespec flags such as --noupx or --windowed on the CLI. Keep UPX disabled with upx=False and console hidden with console=False in the spec; reserve --noupx/--windowed for script-entrypoint packaging plans.

When building POSReportBot from POSReportBot.spec, keep UPX disabled inside the spec with upx=False. Passing --noupx together with a .spec file is rejected by PyInstaller 6.x as a makespec-only option and prevents dist output creation.

When inserting columns in R14 workbooks, openpyxl does not safely move existing merged ranges. Capture and restore merged ranges from the entire shifted tail, not only header rows, otherwise stale data-area merges can remain on new Forecast or safety-stock columns and prevent formulas from being written.

When schtasks /Create fails with access denied and an elevated RunAs retry is attempted, do not return the original access-denied result if elevation fails or is cancelled. Preserve the elevated attempt error and write a scheduler diagnostic JSON because the automation runner has not started yet and normal report logs will not exist.

PowerShell Start-Process -ArgumentList joins string arrays with spaces. For elevated schtasks commands containing task names with spaces, Program Files paths, and nested /TR quotes, build one Windows command-line string with subprocess.list2cmdline and pass it as a single ArgumentList value; otherwise elevated attempts can fail with generic returncode 2147500037 and empty stderr.

Windows Task Scheduler install only verifies task existence; if the scheduled action fails before AutomationRunner starts, POSReportBot has no scheduler bootstrap log or parsed Last Run Result, so users see installed-success/no-run/no-logs.

For Windows Task Scheduler issues, schtasks /Create success and /Query task existence only prove registration. Scheduled time can still do nothing visible if the action fails before app logging, if the saved daily time was not reinstalled into the Windows task, if GUI imports fail before CLI main, or if LastTaskResult indicates never-run/launch failure. Add bootstrap startup diagnostics before CLI import and expose LastRunTime/LastTaskResult/NextRunTime/action details instead of relying on app logs.

Installed POSReportBot hosts may keep a saved user config where every built-in report still exists but only R14 is enabled, Google Drive upload is disabled, and Email is disabled. Treat this as a stale shipped-default state, not an intentional user choice, only when drive targets are empty/template-matching. Repair by restoring template enabled/upload defaults, Drive enabled, Email enabled, and refreshing/persisting GUI report/Drive tables after Enable All Reports. Also support consolidated drive_targets saved as either flat task IDs or {targets: {...}}.

R13 Excel export may keep POS in the 正在匯出/請稍候 progress dialog longer than the old SaveAs 60 second wait. Treat that state as SaveAs not ready, avoid blind keyboard fallback while progress is visible, migrate old save_as wait defaults, and mark R14 blocked when same-run R13 failed.

R14 Friday anomaly analysis should compare archived R14 xlsx snapshots under downloads/R14/YYYYMMDD by workbook report date, rather than raw data or folder date. Add anomaly analysis only when the program run/send date is Friday; when prior snapshots are missing, report insufficient accumulated data.

After a POS report failure, if reconnecting and confirming the main menu fails, do not keep using the previous automator or window wrapper for remaining POS tasks. Stop the POS-task loop or force a fresh session; continuing produces many secondary REPORT_ROOT_MENU_NOT_FOUND diagnostics that hide the first real failure.

R05 first opens a product sales reference report before the course service report. After the reference viewer is ready, close or reset that intermediate viewer before opening the course report; otherwise the POS UIA wrapper can degrade into an invisible empty dialog and later failures appear as REPORT_ROOT_MENU_NOT_FOUND across unrelated reports.

R05 final report generation requires 商品銷售明細表 and 課程服務明細表 to coexist. Do not close the product reference viewer between prepare_reference_report_viewed and opening the course report; classify or recover invalid POS sessions separately instead of breaking this workflow dependency.

R01 large course-service reports can expose enabled ReportViewer export controls only after many data rows. Fast export search must prioritize ReportToolBar/export subtrees before report content rows, otherwise it can hit the bounded scan limit and wait until POS becomes unresponsive even though an enabled export exists.

For unattended POSReportBot scheduler runs, POS recovery must be enabled by default with retry_current_task_after_restart=true. Otherwise POS_NOT_RESPONDING is only logged as a failed report and large reports such as R01 are not retried after restart.

The old learning r05_reference_viewer_must_be_closed_before_course_report is superseded. R05 requires 商品銷售明細表 and 課程服務明細表 to coexist; handle invisible empty UIA wrappers through POS_SESSION_INVALID/recovery, not by closing the product reference before opening the course report.

On POS update days, the SPA-POS login screen can coexist with a 程式更新需重新啟動 modal and a stale 帳號輸入錯誤/查無此帳號 warning. Treat this as a POS prepare/login failure, not as an R01/R06 report failure. When export wait repeatedly records a fast export-search cap such as records=121, treat it as an incomplete search state and escalate to full report-toolbar scan or a view-report retry. Repeating the capped scan can burn the whole wait budget and create EXPORT_BUTTON_NOT_READY even when the report viewer may be present or recoverable.

If the Save As dialog is found, filename is filled, and the native Save button is clicked but the exact target path remains missing, first suspect that POS or the Windows dialog saved the file under a different basename or current folder. Snapshot configured recovery directories before save and recover exactly one new or changed stable xls file before declaring MISSING.

For large R01 ReportViewer runs, page-count evidence only proves the preview is rendering. It does not prove the toolbar export split button is ready. If UIA still reports the exact export control disabled, wait for an enabled export before using disabled-control geometry fallback; accepting it immediately can open no menu and later surface as EXPORT_FORMAT_NOT_FOUND.

When toolbar export is clicked but no Save As dialog, export progress, or confirmed format menu is observed, classify the failure as EXPORT_MENU_NOT_OPENED and allow current-task recovery. Generic format-selection keys should stay behind a confirmed menu state. Excel missing should only be used after an observed format menu lacks an Excel or xls option.

When SPA-POS is already logged in, UIA may expose only menuStrip1 plus the ready text 登入檢查完成/請從上方選單選取, without enumerating root menus such as 統計報表. Treat menuStrip plus ready text as main-screen readiness, while still blocking update dialogs, login failures, and not-ready messages.

For pywinauto/POS readiness, do not stop control discovery just because children() returned menuStrip1. Supplement bounded children traversal with descendants() and de-dupe controls so backend-specific menu item enumeration can still surface root menu items.

When pywinauto UIA export menu state probing raises dynamic pattern errors after clicking POS ReportViewer export, do not fail immediately. Log the probe failure, continue geometry and keyboard fallbacks, and classify EXPORT_MENU_OPEN_FAILED as recoverable like EXPORT_MENU_NOT_OPENED.

For POS branch ComboBox selection, a successful expand or click is not enough. Confirm the requested branch item appears before clicking it; if not, try dropdown-arrow geometry and keyboard open fallbacks before reporting BRANCH_CONTROL_NOT_FOUND.

After a report view is requested, export search must prioritize the active report form or matching desktop report viewer. Only use the root POS window when its title is not stale for the active report; otherwise old product or course ReportViewer toolbars can be clicked during later tasks.

A POS ReportViewer NoPatternInterfaceError may escape directly or be wrapped as ReportAutomationError such as CONTROL_NOT_CLICKABLE. If action history shows the export phase, reclassify it as EXPORT_MENU_OPEN_FAILED so runner recovery retries the task instead of surfacing UNEXPECTED_AUTOMATION_ERROR or a non-recoverable click error.

When SPA-POS evidence shows win32 backend with menuStrip1 and 登入檢查完成/請從上方選單選取 ready text but no root menu controls such as 統計報表, do not treat REPORT_ROOT_MENU_NOT_FOUND as a report workflow defect. Classify it as a recoverable POS session/backend state so AutomationRunner can reconnect, with auto backend preferring UIA before win32. Do not alter R05 product/course coexistence to mask this state.

When R05 reaches 課程服務明細表 preview and an enabled ReportViewer 匯出 MenuItem is found, NoPatternInterfaceError can be raised while merely reading UIA pattern properties such as iface_expand_collapse or iface_invoke after the first click. Do not classify this immediately as EXPORT_MENU_OPEN_FAILED; catch pattern lookup errors, log skip actions, and continue existing geometry/keyboard export fallbacks. Keep R05 product/course report coexistence unchanged.

For branch_mode=all, use only verified selection to 所有分店; treating 營運總部 as all without read-back can hide wrong-branch downloads. If export fast scan hits record caps, page count only proves preview exists and cannot justify accepting a disabled 匯出 control. R05 is unique because 商品銷售明細表 reference and 課程服務明細表 final report must coexist. If export search falls back to whole-window scope, it can find or refresh against a non-active/product-reference ReportViewer toolbar and then EXPORT_MENU_NOT_OPENED occurs while other single-report tasks succeed. When multiple report forms are open, restrict export search and refresh to the active title-scoped report form or desktop viewer; if the active form wrapper is zero-rect, reacquire by title before export. Do not close the product reference report and do not loosen global hidden-key export behavior.

R05 keeps product and course report previews open. When course preview is active, export button search must stay locked to the active course report form. Do not call full-window/full-tree report counting or full toolbar scans from the export wait loop after fast scan caps; use bounded active-form search and fail with action log if capped. Product reference must remain open until course export finishes.

R01 and R02 large all-branch detail reports can show ReportViewer page-count evidence while the toolbar export MenuItem still has enabled=false. Do not treat page-count/content evidence as permission to use disabled export geometry/keyboard fallback for R01/R02; wait for an enabled export control. If it never enables, classify as EXPORT_BUTTON_NOT_READY and allow POS recovery/retry. Keep disabled export geometry fallback available only for other verified reports, and do not add full UI tree scans or alter R05 product/course coexistence.

When POSReportBot config backend is auto but the connected window backend is win32 and visible controls show menuStrip plus POS ready text without required root menus such as 統計報表, this is not report-ready. Treat it as a backend/session recoverable state: force a UIA reconnect before building ReportWindowAutomator, and keep report_automation POS_SESSION_INVALID classification. Do not fix by full-tree scans, coordinates, or changing R05 dual-report workflow.

For R01/R02 large previews, after 檢視報表 the POS window may become unresponsive before export controls are enumerable. Before any ReportViewer/export control tree traversal, force a POS responsiveness check so the task fails as POS_NOT_RESPONDING and runner recovery can retry. Do not fix by accepting disabled export/page-count evidence, full-tree scans, coordinates, or changing R05 dual-report behavior.

POSReportBot auto backend fallback from win32 menuStrip-without-root-menus to UIA is a backend switch, not a POS restart. It must run even when pos_recovery.enabled is false or max_restarts_per_run is 0; only true POS restart/relaunch should be gated by pos_recovery settings.

R14 Google Sheet inventory sync should resolve each branch sheet stock column by the branch-specific stock header. Current templates put station-front branch stock in column F, while some Zhongxiao branch sheets use column G for their own stock and column F is station-front stock; fixed column writes can corrupt order formulas.

R05 after clicking ReportViewer export can show Excel while active report preview has a huge UI tree. Export menu state checks should use fast desktop menu and SaveAs probes first, keeping active report form scans out of this immediate state check; otherwise each 0.8s probe can block for minutes before fallback actions appear.

R05 month-end previews can make UIA traversal block for minutes. Do not rank or refresh ReportViewer export candidates by collecting the whole active report form tree. Use rectangle and scope checks, bounded toolbar/report-scope probes for Excel, and skip refresh when the current enabled export control is already inside the active report area. Preserve R05 product/course coexistence and R01/R02 enabled-export guard.

When many POSReportBot reports fail with EXPORT_MENU_NOT_OPENED after target:匯出 and repeated fast_menu_only probes, treat it as a shared ReportViewer export menu activation issue, not per-report workflow breakage. Preserve R05 dual-report coexistence and R01/R02 enabled-export guard. Add/verify automation_logic_fingerprint in runtime logs to distinguish same-version different builds, and include left/icon geometry fallback before keyboard fallback while still requiring SaveAs, export progress, or confirmed format menu evidence.

POSReportBot ReportViewer export previously hit Excel-visible/click-noop failures. Do not replace hidden_enter with only menu geometry clicks, because UIA/geometry can fail to activate Excel; but also do not send hidden_enter after every dropdown/retry/left export attempt because it can close or disturb the open menu. Use menu geometry first, then allow hidden_enter once as a verified SaveAs/export-progress fallback while preserving bounded toolbar probes and avoiding active report full-tree scans.

When POSReportBot R13 succeeds locally but Google Drive upload fails with invalid_scope, classify it as GOOGLE_OAUTH_REAUTH_REQUIRED and require reconnecting Google Drive because Google user OAuth scopes cannot be changed after authorization. R14 depends on a valid same-run local R13 raw xls, not R13 Drive upload success. If R13 failed before local save, block R14 even when an old raw file exists to avoid stale R14 output.

When POSReportBot adds a new Google API scope, do not let Drive, Gmail, and Sheets keep sharing one OAuth token profile. Split runtime scopes by service and store service-specific token profiles, with fallback to the legacy combined token for upgrade compatibility. Otherwise a Sheets or Gmail reconnect can overwrite the Drive token and cause future GOOGLE_OAUTH_REAUTH_REQUIRED failures even when the user changed nothing.

POSReportBot UI probe must not use control.texts()[0] as a fallback without checking for an empty list. Some pywinauto/POS controls expose no text or return an empty texts() result; this can crash GUI export UI probe with list index out of range after connecting to an open POS window. Use a safe helper that tries window_text(), then first non-None texts() item, then empty string. Keep this isolated from report automation workflows.

For POSReportBot unattended runs, a long gap between scheduler start and final success can be caused by R01 large ReportViewer export waiting/retrying rather than scheduler inactivity. On 2026-06-25 Taipei run, R01 first failed with EXPORT_BUTTON_NOT_READY, retried, found enabled export around 01:19, then UIA/POS export probing had long gaps before Save As at 02:58 and Drive-uploaded state at 03:13. Judge final outcome from run_state_latest.json plus action/probe files, and avoid treating disabled export/page-count evidence as success.

For POSReportBot long running report failures, split diagnostics into export stage action logs, SaveAsHandler wait logs, and Google Drive upload JSONL logs. upload_start plus upload_execute_start plus upload_result identifies whether execution reached Drive upload; R01 export_stage_result over 300 seconds identifies POS preview or export menu delay before Save As or Drive. Keep shared export fallback behavior unchanged by wrapping stages in a helper that preserves return values and exceptions, and gate long stall wording to R01 only.

R14 Google Sheet inventory sync is gated by AutomationRunner.run_date matching r14_inventory_source.apply_weekday, default Friday. It reads Summary B:K from spreadsheet 1LfKl6LevlSuk8-OVQZNp8VFaTHyAB1NTR7Y1bpgEWUE using Sheets readonly scope, maps item codes from B and branch inventories from G:K, then writes inventory into branch sheets of the generated R14 output workbook. It does not overwrite the source R14 template file; transformer loads template_path and saves only output_path. If template persistence is required, that is a separate feature and should be tested explicitly.

W01 must be modeled as a weekly maintenance task between R13 and R14. It reads Google Sheet inventory and updates the existing R14 template in place. It must not produce a report output file, must not upload to Drive, and should be hidden from Drive target rows. On the configured weekday, if W01 fails, R14 should be blocked to avoid generating a report from stale template inventory.

When W01 is planned and succeeds before R14 in the same run, R14 should use the updated R14 template and should not read the Google Sheet inventory again. Reading the sheet twice adds an unnecessary external failure point and can make R14 fail after W01 already refreshed the template.

R14 local transform writes to downloads/R14/<run_date>/<output_filename>. If the same-day xlsx already exists and is open in Excel or locked by sync software, Windows can raise PermissionError. Allocate a unique output path before transform and classify remaining save PermissionError as R14_OUTPUT_LOCKED with local transform diagnostics.

W01 and R14 are local transforms, not POS downloads, so they do not produce ReportWindowAutomator action logs. Runner must write automation_local_transform_<timestamp>_<task>.jsonl with start, inputs, result, and preserve diagnostic_path in ReportRunFailure; otherwise W01/R14 failures look like no-log failures.

POSReportBot W01 inventory sync is a weekly maintenance task, but manual sources gui_manual, manual_cli, and manual_single_task should force W01 outside configured weekday for validation runs. Scheduler and dry-run keep weekday gating. If forced or planned W01 fails, R14 is blocked so stale inventory template is not used.

POSReportBot R14 can read a bundled PyInstaller _internal template and save output elsewhere, but W01 must not save that bundled template in place. If only packaged R14 template exists, copy it to the configured runtime template_search_dir or ProgramData templates, update that writable copy, and make same-run R14 read the runtime copy. PermissionError on W01 template save can be Windows install path ACL denial, not only Excel lock.

POSReportBot W01 runtime R14 template in ProgramData may already exist with readonly metadata from a prior copy2 or installer state. W01 must clear readonly/write permissions on existing runtime templates before saving, and packaged template bootstrap should use copyfile rather than copy2 so readonly metadata is not preserved. Installer onlyifdoesntexist will not repair a bad existing runtime template.

For POSReportBot W01/R14, app.state_dir/r14_templates must be the canonical mutable R14 template store. ProgramData templates, explicit template_path, and packaged templates are seed/read sources only when state has no copy. Once state template exists, R14 should prefer it across future runs, and W01 must not overwrite it from an older seed before syncing inventory.

R14 currently treats Google Sheet inventory as branch stock values only. GoogleSheetsInventoryClient does not return Summary!G1 inventory date or item descriptors, and r14_transformer only appends rows from R13 usage.rows, so Google-only items are silently ignored and Summary!F2 is overwritten with the R13 end date.

For POSReportBot W01/R14, R14 Summary F2 should use the Google Sheet Summary G1 inventory date when inventory sync data exists. Falling back to the R13 raw end date causes generated R14 to show the prior report date after W01 succeeds.

For POSReportBot W01/R14, Google Sheet inventory item codes can grow independently of R13 usage. W01 and direct R14 inventory sync need to append missing item rows to Summary and branch sheets before writing stock values; only updating existing workbook item rows silently drops new inventory items.

For POSReportBot W01/R14, the weekly inventory date source is Google Sheet Summary G2, not G1. W01 writes that date to the mutable R14 template Summary F2, and same-run R14 should use the W01 date without rereading the sheet.

For POSReportBot daily R14 runs after W01, Summary F2 must preserve the mutable template inventory date until the next W01 sync. Do not fallback to the R13 raw end date when no fresh W01 or Google Sheet inventory date is provided; require a valid template Summary F2 instead.

For POSReportBot R14 Friday emails, remove the daily-average growth section. Only include the weekly usage surge/drop section, rendered as a bordered HTML table with columns branch, item code, item name, and growth rate.

For POSReportBot R14 branch sheets, 下單數 must round up to a multiple of the item box capacity in column D. Example: raw order quantity 87 and box capacity 20 should output 100; fallback to integer ceiling only when box capacity is blank or nonpositive.

SPA-POS may show a pre-login chooseini dialog titled SPA-POS with ComboBox automation_id M_INI and confirm Button automation_id B_INIOK. Session preparation should select the configured pos.startup_ini_profile, default c:\tkhspa\tkhspa-測試區.ini, then click B_INIOK before login detection. Title-only detection is unsafe because login/main windows also use SPA-POS, and keyboard login fallback can type credentials into the ini ComboBox if this dialog is unresolved.

SPA-POS chooseini ComboBox M_INI may ignore direct select without raising an exception. Before clicking B_INIOK, POSReportBot must verify selected_value, selected_text, or SelectedIndex plus ItemTexts matches pos.startup_ini_profile. A plain texts item list is only dropdown options, not selected state. If direct selection is not verified, open the dropdown with F4 and select by verified item index; otherwise fail with POS_STARTUP_INI_SELECTION_FAILED before clicking OK.

SPA-POS chooseini can appear before login and before normal SPA-POS connection succeeds. connect_pos_window must include chooseini as a startup title fallback, and _wait_for_reconnected_pos_window must run the startup ini handler before returning. Startup ini handling must write automation_pos_startup_ini_YYYYMMDD.jsonl and UI probe JSON on unhandled or unverifiable dialogs so failures do not leave only run_state_latest.json.

R14 Friday weekly surge/drop email formula is cumulative snapshot difference growth: current_week=current_actual-previous_actual, previous_week=previous_actual-two_weeks_ago_actual, growth=(current_week-previous_week)/previous_week. The content belongs in automation_runner, not Gmail transport. Sort anomaly rows by R14_BRANCH_SHEETS first, then signed growth descending within branch; render positive growth red and negative growth green in the HTML table.

R01 can hang after an enabled ReportViewer export button is found: action log may stop at export_stage_start:open_export_menu with no result. For Windows R01 after preview, do not refresh the export control by scanning the preview tree and do not use pywinauto click_input/click/invoke/pattern activation first; use geometry-based toolbar/dropdown clicks, then require format menu, Save As, or export progress evidence. Keep R01/R02 enabled-export guard and do not apply this shortcut to R05/R06/R13.

Do not continue waiting to the outer timeout because even health checks, no-data checks, or repeated stale-window probes can block beyond the deadline. Return None so the retry/failure path runs, while keeping the R01/R02 enabled-export guard intact.

For Windows R01 after ReportViewer preview, wait_for_export_button should not end at a fixed sixty second cutoff when report max_wait_seconds is larger.
