Root fix: keep R01 and R02 enabled-export guard plus bounded toolbar-only scans, avoid full ReportViewer preview-tree scans, and respect configured initial and retry wait budgets so late-enabled export buttons can be detected.

For Windows R01 large month-end ReportViewer generation, POS responsiveness probes can temporarily report no response after the ReportViewer toolbar/export control has already appeared but before export becomes enabled. Evidence on 2026-06-29 showed v8 failed with POS_NOT_RESPONDING at 38 to 90 seconds while timeout was 300 seconds, and a later UI probe showed ClassService_Report, ReportToolBar, Export, and Excel controls visible/enabled. Root fix: keep the initial R01/R02 health check before export traversal, but after R01 toolbar export evidence is seen, log and defer transient POS_NOT_RESPONDING until the configured export wait deadline. Do not accept disabled export and do not apply this defer behavior to R05/R06/R13.

R01 export safety must distinguish full ReportViewer preview scans from bounded ReportToolBar menu-subtree scans. After geometry-clicking an enabled toolbar export button, a visible and enabled Excel MenuItem can appear under ReportToolBar; confirm and click that observed control with record and depth limits, while still forbidding preview/grid traversal, hidden Enter, and guessed Excel coordinates when no confirmed control exists.

R01 export wait timeout is only checked between synchronous UIA scans; a single desktop ReportViewer discovery or child traversal can block far beyond the configured budget, as observed when wait_for_export_button timeout was 300s but elapsed 1333s. For Windows R01 after preview, export search scopes must avoid desktop ReportViewer enumeration, R01 fast-scan limit must not fall into deeper active-form bounded scans, and late controls returned after deadline must be rejected instead of clicked.

R01 ReportViewer export wait may return an enabled MenuItem that has empty name/id and rectangle 0,0,0,0 while the visual Excel dropdown is present. Treat this as a stale or ghost export target: do not geometry-click it, do not remember its toolbar scope, and keep searching only bounded toolbar scopes. Preserve disabled-but-visible toolbar export evidence for POS-busy deferral; require enabled only when actually clicking.

R01 ReportViewer export can show the Excel option visually after a valid toolbar export click while UIA/menu probes do not expose an Excel control in bounded toolbar scope. Do not restore ReportViewer deep scans or send unknown-focus keys. For R01 only, after a valid export click, allow a fallback only when a top-level #32768 popup is visible near and below the export button; then click the popup first row or named Excel control and require Save As or export progress evidence immediately.

R10 can hit the same ReportViewer export failure mode as R01: after preview, pywinauto UIA click/pattern/keyboard fallbacks can block or fail for minutes. Keep R10 on a geometry-only export open path and only click Excel after a nearby popup or Save As is observed; do not broaden this to R05/R06/R13 without evidence.

After a POS task failure, fresh connect can fail even while the existing SPA-POS main window is still readable and contains required root menus. Before aborting downstream POS tasks, validate the current window with preparation and required-root checks; only abort if current window and fresh reconnect both fail.

EXPORT_MENU_NOT_OPENED means safe detection did not confirm popup, Save As, or progress after deterministic export clicks; it does not prove POS is dead. Do not spend limited POS restart budget on this class because later real hangs need recovery capacity.

When R01 preview/export is active, evidence can show active_report_form invisible or rect zero and stale window titles; full report form refresh during export wait can spend hundreds of seconds. Keep R01 export scope on toolbar fast paths and log the skip instead of rescanning the whole ReportViewer.

R13 can click Excel successfully and enter the POS progress modal but not show Save As within 300 seconds on large data. Use a larger bounded SaveAs timeout for R13, cancel stuck progress on EXPORT_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT, and surface a recoverable error so runner can restart and retry R13 before R14.

For R01 and R10 geometry-only export, a valid export click may need a short delay before the confirmed menu popup becomes observable. Wait briefly for a confirmed popup or progress evidence before returning EXPORT_MENU_NOT_OPENED; still do not guess Excel coordinates or send unknown-focus keys without confirmation.

R10 can share the R01 ReportViewer export failure mode: geometry-only export click is safe, but export-format detection must not enter bounded_report_scope or preview-tree enumeration. Use desktop popup plus bounded toolbar scope only, fail fast with EXPORT_MENU_NOT_OPENED when no confirmed popup, Save As, or progress exists, and do not send unknown-focus keys or guess Excel coordinates.

R01/R10 geometry-only export should preserve evidence before ESC cleanup when the Excel popup is not confirmed. The probe should stay bounded to top-level windows, #32768 popup menus, and limited popup descendants because manual UI probing dismisses transient menus and ReportViewer preview scans have previously caused hangs.

R01/R10 ReportViewer export dropdown can appear as a small visible enabled titleless WindowsForms10.Window.20808 top-level popup near the export button, with SysShadow beside it, not only as #32768. Confirm this bounded near-export popup before clicking the first row, keep Save As or export-progress proof after click, and avoid ReportViewer preview scans or unknown-focus keys.

R09 uses the same 客戶來源與產值統計表 ReportViewer export surface as R10. Evidence from the 2026-07-01 scheduled run showed R09 on v17 found the enabled report-toolbar export button, entered the general export path, repeated bounded_report_scope scans for 1855 seconds, then tried hidden_enter and failed EXPORT_MENU_NOT_OPENED before Save As. R09 belongs in the geometry-only near-popup export path with R01 and R10 so it can use bounded WinForms or #32768 popup confirmation and avoid preview-tree enumeration.

POSReportBot W02 must not mark success or advance next_run_date when any order item is skipped or abnormal. Only a fully completed POS ordering workflow, or a plan with no order forms and no issues, may advance W02 by 14 days.

POSReportBot W02 should be implemented in two layers: deterministic order plan from R14 and Google Sheet department mapping first, then separately verified POS order submission. Until POS submission is validated, generated plans are evidence but not successful ordering.

When POSReportBot W02 reports skipped items, first verify Google Sheet Summary B:F department mapping. Distinguish missing item code in Summary B from existing item code with blank Summary F; both must stop W02 from false success and tell the user exactly which sheet field to fix.

POSReportBot W02 must skip abnormal order items such as missing department mapping, email the W02 abnormal report, and continue normal order items. It may advance next_run_date only after all normal order forms are completed, or when there are no normal forms and all issues were reported. It must not advance when normal forms remain unsubmitted because POS submission is disabled or failed.

W02 POS order creation must not treat no exception or clicked Save/Confirm/Approve buttons as success. Require observable POS evidence such as order status showing approved, write an in_progress ledger before touching POS, record a plan signature after completion, and stop for manual review if a rerun sees an in_progress or pending verification state to avoid duplicate orders.

W02 POS branch switching uses the account menu plus a nested branch ComboBox. W02 item picker on SPA-POS may expose L_Count=1 plus generic cells like 商品碼 資料列 0 and 選 資料列 0 without an independent 資料列 0 row control or visible item code text. W02 order plan must use the actual generated R14 workbook for the run date, but when evaluating R14 下單數 formulas, the elapsed day must resolve the branch sheet F2 formula chain such as =Summary!F2 or =站前4樓!F2. W02 diagnostic mode should build and persist the full order plan from the runtime R14 report, then submit only a diagnostic subset of up to three normal order items per branch. It must not advance next_run_date in diagnostic mode. Do not put diagnostic truncation inside build_w02_order_plan because the plan JSON must remain full-fidelity evidence.

W02 after clicking POS 訂貨存檔 must poll for the success prompt before clicking 確認. Keep this optimization scoped to W02 automator instead of moving it into shared R01-R14 report automation.

W02 after clicking POS B_Appv can show a 核准確認 modal with affirmative button text like 是(Y), followed by a separate completion prompt. After each completed form, close the 分店訂貨單 window before switching branch, and use per-form action slices for failed_before_pos_submission ledger decisions so a previous form save/approve does not make the next pre-submit failure non-rerunnable.

Verify cL_BranchName after B_Add before entering items.

W02 diagnostic mode still performs real POS test orders and can collect POS-side skipped issues such as W02_POS_ITEM_NOT_FOUND. Diagnostic success paths must call the same W02 abnormal email notification used by normal mode when plan issues or submit skipped issues exist, while keeping next_run_date unchanged. When W02 order plan succeeds but POS submission fails before actions with W02_POS_CONNECTION_FAILED, the failure is in shared POS session preparation, not R14/W02 item planning. Keep fallback after the existing Application.connect path to avoid regressing R01-R13 successful connections.

W02 diagnostic mode has two separate contracts: the pre-POS diagnostic sample should require 3 branches with 3 planned R14 order items each; if the runtime R14 plan cannot provide 3x3, fail before POS with clear counts and do not create partial diagnostic orders. Once POS submission starts, missing POS item codes remain skippable anomalies: record W02_POS_ITEM_NOT_FOUND, close picker, continue later items, and notify at the end. Keep missing POS item codes skippable and reported at end.

When R14 order formula changes, update both R14 workbook formula generation and W02 offline R14 formula evaluator together. W02 must read cached R14 values when available and only re-evaluate formulas with the same R14 semantics when cached values are missing. Keep legacy DAY($F$2)*14 parser only for historical workbooks, not newly generated R14 files.

Never copy whole rows by position from Summary to branch history sheets; procurement can reorder/add/delete items and branch columns. If the full key is still non-unique and stock is nonzero, fail/report for manual cleanup instead of choosing a row.

Inventory history sync must not only write Summary authority rows; it must also clear the current inventory-date column for branch-sheet rows whose 凱惠料號+品名 / full key is no longer present in Summary. Preserve historical rows and old date columns, but set the current synced date value to 0 for non-authority rows. 在 SPA-POS R09/R01/R10 ReportViewer 匯出等待中，第一次找到 toolbar 內的匯出候選後必須快取 toolbar scope；後續 wait、存在性與 disabled 空白判斷只可重用該 bounded toolbar，不能每輪回到 active form 或完整 post-report preview tree。disabled toolbar 的空白判斷只能使用有限 toolbar-level controls，未確認匯出選單、另存新檔或進度時仍必須 fail closed。

W02 的 w02_order.next_run_date 是排程與一般 --run-enabled batch 的硬閘門；只有 GUI 的立即執行選取任務與明確 --run-task W02 才能 force。不得讓 run_source=manual_cli 代表批次 force，否則正式 POS 會在日期未到時真實下單。force 也不能繞過 w02_order.enabled。

W02 單獨執行沒有 R14 計畫項時，仍要從 R14 設定的 date_range.end 推導預期報表日，且只掃 C:\ProgramData\POSReportBot\downloads\R14\<本輪 YYYYMMDD>；候選必須通過可讀 workbook/template 結構與內容報表日期驗證，不能只靠檔名、mtime 或舊日期資料夾。已有本輪 R14 provenance 時，無效本輪檔案要 fail closed，不可回退封存舊檔。

Unmerge only ranges intersecting row 2 so F1:I1 and data-area merges remain intact; keep F2 as a date value with custom number format.

R14 runtime metadata may expose downloads_dir as C:\ProgramData\POSReportBot\downloads\YYYYMMDD while historical snapshots remain under C:\ProgramData\POSReportBot\downloads\R14. Keep root and one-level date-folder scan, strict filename date and six-branch Actual validation, and never broaden W02 current-run provenance.

When R14 reports PREVIOUS_MONTH_END_SNAPSHOT_MISSING although a file exists, distinguish path absence from candidate rejection. A matching -YYYYMMDD.xlsx can still be unusable when it lacks the current six-branch sheets or previous-month Actual group. On Windows, switching R05 from the product reference report to the course report can leave the native UIA menu_select call blocked for minutes while the course menu leaf remains hidden. When the known product form is still active, bypass only that native call and use the bounded POS-owned root-menu popup/reopen path; keep hidden/disabled leaf rejection, no Desktop-wide scan, and the existing product-reference-before-course workflow.

In R05 after the product reference report, a visible/enabled WinForms root menu can accept click_input without exposing a usable child popup; the static child remains hidden and REPORT_MENU_NOT_FOUND follows. In the narrowly identified product-to-course switch, try one root-level MenuItem select() and then require a POS-owned visible/enabled course leaf and course form inputs. For a July R14 transform, archives from 2026/06/11 through 2026/07/23 do not replace the required previous-month-end 2026/06/30 snapshot. During sync into the current six-branch runtime template, write numeric 0 to the new branch Summary and branch Actual cells by item code; do not leave them blank or copy another branch. Keep arbitrary missing existing branches fail-closed.

R02 的 WinForms 分店 ComboBox 不能把第一項當作「所有分店」；實機診斷顯示鍵盤第一項實際選成「營運總部」。優先從 ComboBox 取得 item_texts/texts，對「所有分店」做精確文字/別名比對後以索引選取並 read-back 驗證；若無法讀取項目清單，只能保留鍵盤 fallback 並要求選取值驗證，否則 fail closed。

pywinauto/comtypes initialize COM only on the thread that first imports them; a GUI automation runner moved to a QThread must explicitly CoInitializeEx/CoUninitialize that worker thread around the complete UIA lifetime. Fsync an append-only phase journal before and after every POS/UIA boundary, enable faulthandler for native faults, finalize SystemExit-like failures, and collect Authenticode plus Defender/Code Integrity/Application Error evidence separately before naming the root cause.

The 2.1.9 Inno compile succeeded, but build_installer.ps1 still post-processed POSReportBotSetup-2.1.8.exe because the output filename was hardcoded. This is not proof that Enter failed or the app is missing. Read ProductVersion from Get-Item ... VersionInfo for operator-visible version checks, and never make an operational script depend on stdout from the windowed executable.

Historical backfill invokes a windowed POSReportBot executable. Use Start-Process -Wait -PassThru and inspect the returned process ExitCode for every task; the interactive PowerShell call operator may return control without usable stdout and is not a reliable completion signal. Keep each operator command on one pasteable line, and use the application's ProgramData logs plus Drive file ID as final task evidence.

A 2.1.10 scheduled batch showed unrelated-looking R02-R05 control failures while its screenshots simultaneously captured a historical backfill console, SPA-POS restart splash, and POS exit-confirmation dialog. Two POSReportBot processes were starting, closing, reconnecting, and changing the same SPA-POS UI. Treat this as a cross-report process-coordination failure, not several selector failures: every independent AutomationRunner must acquire the batch reservation and actual automation mutex before connecting to POS, and lock refusal must return before any POS action. Partial successes in the same batch do not disprove the race because collision timing differs by task.

A historical backfill is one logical POS owner even though it launches one windowed EXE per task. Hold a batch-reservation mutex for the complete batch and require each child EXE to hold a separate actual-automation mutex. The process-scoped parent token may bypass only the parent's batch reservation, never the actual automation mutex. This prevents Task Scheduler from entering gaps between tasks and also keeps POS protected if the parent PowerShell is closed while a child is still running. An independently launched scheduler does not inherit the token and must fail before touching POS; an already-running scheduler must likewise make backfill stop before its first task.

POSReportBot.exe is a windowed PyInstaller executable, so an operator may see no stdout when a concurrent run is refused. Persist AUTOMATION_ALREADY_RUNNING in the scheduler runner_finished startup diagnostic and retain owner metadata while the mutex is held; a generic message printed only to stdout is not operational evidence. This lets support distinguish intentional fail-closed exclusion from a silent crash without reintroducing a console window.

A login window titled 帳號登入 contains the same 帳號 token as the account label. Searching every non-Edit control as a label makes the Window itself match first and maps the first unrelated Edit to the username; reversed child order can map the password field as the account field. Restrict positional login-label matching to label-like Text/Static/Label controls, retain named-edit priority, and use row geometry when available.

Safe UI readers intentionally suppress wrapper exceptions, but suppressing an invalid-window-handle error turns a reconnectable stale login wrapper into a generic startup timeout. Probe login-window liveness strictly only for invalid-handle evidence. When credential entry invalidates a wrapper, reconnect and retry the normal verifiable control login once before keyboard fallback; a newly connected form may be healthy even though the old edit wrapper was stale. This timing defect can make an overnight scheduled report fail while a later manual rerun succeeds and affects every report sharing the login layer.

Breaking out of AutomationRunner after POS restart and reconnect both fail can leave pending reports absent from the failure summary and run state. Apply the same recovery path to raised ReportAutomationError and ReportDownloadResult.ok=False. If the current POS window is still verified ready, continue safely; otherwise mark every remaining POS output failed, then still evaluate local dependency gates so R14 is explicitly BLOCKED_BY_R13_FAILED instead of silently disappearing or consuming stale data.

After W02 began validating the selected R14 workbook date, old minimal fixtures with only Summary plus one branch failed before the behavior under test. Build fixtures with the planner's report date (normally run date minus one), all six branch sheets, the prior-month Actual column, and 領用表; keep wrong-date archive files fail-closed. If an old fixture waits 300 seconds and fails closed, update the fixture or common fake helper; never weaken the production gate to accept arbitrary same-name controls.

AutomationRunner, GUI runtime, and run-lock tests share the real Windows named mutexes Local\POSReportBot.AutomationBatch and Local\POSReportBot.AutomationRunner. Running those files in parallel produces large numbers of false AUTOMATION_ALREADY_RUNNING failures and can make child lock tests exit before printing LOCKED. Run all mutex-owning test groups serially; only parallelize files that do not acquire the process-wide POS lock.

A W02 quantity-verification unit test that did not replace _clipboard_get_text/_clipboard_set_text reached win32clipboard.SetClipboardData and terminated pytest with Windows heap corruption 0xc0000374. Unit tests must inject or monkeypatch clipboard behavior even when a fake keyboard sender is present. Keep production clipboard cleanup in finally, and validate any native clipboard integration in an isolated subprocess rather than the main unit-test process.

Legacy success tests expected R01/R09 to use UIA invoke, Alt+Down, or Enter after an export geometry click even when no Excel menu, SaveAs dialog, or POS export progress was confirmed. Those expectations reintroduce the same unknown-focus risk that caused unstable exports. Keep the production path fail-closed: exact stable export identity where required, bounded menu evidence, and no keyboard or invoke fallback from an unconfirmed state. Convert legacy success tests into negative regression tests instead of weakening the gate.

A report viewer fake that exists before the View Report action can be mistaken for the active configuration form, while a retry geometry click that does not call the fake control callback never enables export. Expected-success tests must create the viewer after report generation, give known viewer/export controls visible geometry, invoke the fake callback on retry geometry, and register only bounded known forms for post-save close. This preserves production anti-scan safeguards while accurately testing retry and close behavior.

The full 765-case Windows suite can exceed a 30-minute orchestration limit because W02 and ReportAutomation intentionally exercise bounded waits. Persist JUnit output during the full serial run. If the orchestrator terminates pytest, distinguish the terminal-writer internal error from product failures, identify the last completed node, and rerun the exact unexecuted tail serially. Here the first JUnit covered 730 real tests with zero failures and one skip; the exact remaining 35 tests then passed, yielding complete 765-case coverage without rerunning already proven slow cases.

Windows PowerShell 5.1 can decode a UTF-8-without-BOM runtime JSON file using the active ANSI code page when Get-Content omits -Encoding UTF8. Chinese text becomes mojibake and ConvertFrom-Json may emit a misleading structural parse error even though the file is valid. Re-read runtime JSON with Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 before diagnosing file corruption. The 2026-08-11 run_state_latest.json then parsed correctly and proved app_version 2.1.10 with partial_failed status.

Audit historical POSReportBot uploads by planner run-date semantics and configured Drive folder ID, not by createdTime or exact filename alone. A --today date can map to yesterday in R01/R02/R03/R05/R07/R11/R12/R13/R14, while R06/R08/R09/R10 use today in the filename. Normalize only known historical variants inside the correct task folder: R09/R10 timestamp suffixes, R06 忠孝預防3F versus 忠孝預防醫學3F, R03 全部 versus 僅新客, and R05 prefix differences. This reduced false missing results from 91 to 67 for 2026-07-30 through 2026-08-11 while still counting folder 5 despite its 不需上傳 label.

A complete run_state_latest.json.tmp plus PermissionError WinError 5 on Path.replace proves the JSON serialization succeeded and the destination replacement was denied before any POS action. Keep temp-plus-replace atomicity, but retry transient PermissionError with a short bounded backoff; do not switch to direct in-place writes that can leave half a JSON document. Preserve the final exception and tmp evidence if every retry fails.

When POS explicitly confirms an exact R13 query has zero rows, blocking R14 forever is unnecessary, but searching stale raw data is unsafe. Clear any old marker before R13, then persist a marker bound to app version, planner run date, query start/end and output name. R14 may create a zero-usage workbook only when every marker date matches; it must log r14_no_data_marker and imported_rows=0. All other R13 failures and malformed or mismatched markers remain fail-closed.

A missing expected Drive filename is not always a recoverable upload gap. If the POS action log and screenshot prove the exact task, all-branch selection and date interval returned no data, classify that file as a no-data exception, not as a command that can produce an upload. Keep downstream derived outputs actionable when they can safely use an exact no-data marker. In the 2026-07-30 through 2026-08-11 audit, 38 filenames were absent but only 37 were recoverable uploads because 2026-08-04 R13 was confirmed zero-data while R14 remained producible.

A complete writable run_state_latest.json.tmp plus persistent WinError 5 replacing the existing canonical state can be caused by a Windows open-handle/share denial even when the destination is not read-only. Clearing write attributes and retrying is insufficient. Reproduce with a real Windows open handle before classifying the failure, and do not let a replaceable latest-state index block core POS work.

When only canonical run_state_latest.json replacement remains denied after bounded retries, keep atomic semantics and write run_state_recovery_<execution_id>.json in the same writable state directory. Switch that execution's active store to the recovery path for all later task and final updates, and record primary path, active path and LATEST_STATE_REPLACE_DENIED in the runtime journal. Never fall back to a direct non-atomic overwrite.

In R05's dual-MDI workflow, a visible pn_OtherQuery panel is not proof that cK_ReQuery has materialized. Maximize only that verified course child before opening the panel, preserve the product-reference form and one-preview workflow, restore the child afterward, and never compensate with a global Desktop scan or coordinates.

Do not classify R05 cK_ReQuery as removed from a control tree captured before the complete user-verified course workflow. The failing 2.1.18 run omitted the course-stage 顯示退費 option, and 2.1.19 then inspected pn_OtherQuery/cT_OnlyCSID and raised R05_SECONDARY_FILTER_REMOVED before clicking 其他條件. When a parent PowerShell reserves Local\POSReportBot.AutomationBatch for a historical batch, every child POSReportBot.exe must inherit a non-empty process-scoped POSREPORTBOT_PARENT_RUN_LOCK. Without that token, the child attempts to acquire the parent's batch mutex, immediately returns AUTOMATION_ALREADY_RUNNING, produces no report action evidence, and can be misdiagnosed as a report failure. Keep the parent batch mutex for scheduler exclusion, keep each child AutomationRunner mutex for actual POS serialization, restore the environment and release the parent mutex in finally, and distinguish an idle no-argument Settings Center process from an automation lock owner.

Treat a historical backfill manifest as mutable remaining work. After every Drive readback or real-POS success, assert the exact PreviewOnly child-call counts by scope and key dependency lines before shipping it. For the 2026-08-13 audit after successful 7/1 R04, the contract is All=54, NonR05=43, R05=11; All starts with 2026-07-01 R06, excludes 2026-07-01 R04 and 2026-08-04 R13/W01/R14, and includes R13→W01→R14 for both 7/18 and 7/19. Count child calls separately from Drive outputs because one R06 call creates six branch outputs and W01 creates no Drive output.

When validating POSReportBot dry-run JSON in PowerShell, read payload.counts.missing_drive_targets. Do not count a guessed top-level payload.missing_drive_targets with @(...).Count: the absent property evaluates as null but this PowerShell shape can report a count of 1, creating a false configuration failure. Also use payload.counts.outputs for the authoritative output count and inspect the JSON schema before writing artifact gates.

Resume historical backfill from explicit summary evidence instead of rerunning all earlier successes. Only SUCCESS, NO_DATA_CONTINUE, and ALREADY_SUCCESS rows may suppress a normal task; FAILED rows never do. R14 is a dependency unit: skip the chain only when the same-date R14 itself is already successful. If R14 is incomplete, force the full same-date R13→W01→R14 chain even when prior summary rows claim R13 or W01 success, so a resumed process cannot consume an unproven half-chain. Preview the resumed scope and assert its exact first task/count before real POS execution.

An R05 CHECKBOX_NOT_FOUND message for 顯示退費 is not enough to choose a selector or timing fix because R05 requires that same option in both the product-reference and course-service forms. The output filename and outer REPORT_RUN_FAILED wrapper do not identify the phase. Require the automation_actions R05 phase sequence plus failure diagnostic/UI probe (or an exact rerun from a release that auto-bundles them) before changing required/optional semantics, automation IDs, or wait policy. Do not infer a slow-loading checkbox merely from historical adaptive-preview issues; preview generation and report-form option materialization are different seams.

The 2026-07-18 R05 CHECKBOX_NOT_FOUND for 顯示退費 was not a missing option or report-generation delay. Failure actions proved the product reference fully completed, the course form opened, dates/all branches were set, and 顯示銷售分店 was checked. Immediately afterward the active course wrapper was invisible with a zero rectangle, report/date-input scope was empty, and lookup fell back to the POS shell. A WinForms option toggle can replace/invalidate the active MDI child wrapper. On a required checkbox miss, only when the verified active form is invisible or has lost its date inputs, perform one bounded title-scoped live-form rebind and retry the checkbox. Keep the required option fail-closed if retry fails; do not make it optional, infer removal, add preview timeout, or scan Desktop globally.

Do not use a cleanup-time zero rectangle to require that an R05 wrapper be invisible before rebinding. The 2026-08-14 pre-cleanup UI probe on POS 1.5.19.36 showed the course form still visible with a normal rectangle while its option subtree was incomplete after 顯示銷售分店. When an expected checkbox is absent, perform one bounded same-title fresh-root enumeration even if the remembered wrapper still appears visible or date-bearing; let the fresh root wrapper win identity de-duplication, then retry and remain fail-closed if the checkbox is still absent.

If an option has known checkbox automation IDs, a miss must not call a generic combo-value selector. In the 2026-08-14 R05 failure, that fallback opened the unrelated branch ComboBox while searching for 顯示退費. Restrict combo fallback to options whose contract is actually a combo and keep required checkbox misses fail-closed. Test fakes must not use a ComboBox that accepts arbitrary text to mask missing required checkbox fixtures; the full report suite exposed eight such R09 fixtures and they were corrected instead of restoring the unsafe product fallback.

A WinForms DataGridView may visibly show the blank new row and its 選取商品 cell after many W02 items while UIA no longer exposes a named cell for that row. The 2026-08-14 failure added 23 exact items, then failed on row index 23 for item 6200006 although the screenshot showed the * row and blank selector cell. Use direct named-cell lookup first; on miss, derive one click from the exact column-header center and exact visible row center only when that row spans the header x-coordinate. Keep ItemsWin appearance, exact item-code selection, order-row code readback, quantity readback and pre-save fail-closed gates unchanged.

Do not use a failure JSON written after ESC/close cleanup to infer the control's state at the first error. For R05, the post-cleanup diagnostic showed invisible zero-rectangle forms, while the pre-cleanup UI probe showed the course dialog visible and normal-sized. Rank action logs and pre-cleanup probe/screenshot above cleanup-time summaries when diagnosing UI wrapper lifetime; preserve both and label their phase explicitly.

A W02 failure after item entry but before any w02_save_order/confirm/approve action is strong evidence that the visible form was not committed, but an existing in_progress ledger must still block automatic rerun. First verify in POS that no same-date branch/department order exists and cancel any still-open 新單; only then back up and clear or reclassify the specific ledger entry. Never delete the whole ledger or auto-resume from item 24, because a crash or unobserved prompt can make local action history incomplete.

The 2026-08-14 second POS 1.5.19.36 pre-cleanup probe showed a normal visible ClassService_Report after a successful fresh-root rebind, but no cK_ShowExgBack or visible 顯示退費. The user then changed the business contract: remove 顯示退費 only from the R05 course-service stage; retain it in the product-reference stage. Migrate saved R05 report options and keep a runtime legacy-option guard so old reports.yaml cannot reintroduce CHECKBOX_NOT_FOUND. Do not apply this removal to R02/R03/R11/R12 or R05 product reference.

A W02 local-transform PermissionError on w02_order_plan_<date>.json can happen before any POS or ledger action because the old implementation overwrote one fixed same-day file in place. Write the plan atomically; if replacement of the canonical file remains denied, write a unique recovery JSON in the same directory and propagate that actual path through POS submission, email, actions, messages, and ReportDownloadResult. Preserve failure when the directory itself cannot be written, and never treat plan recovery as permission to bypass the in-progress ledger gate.

A delayed W02 save-success prompt can be missed even with a five-second loop when each iteration enumerates the whole Windows Desktop before refreshing the bounded POS child tree; one slow UIA Desktop scan can consume the deadline. Poll the POS window tree several times first, then enable Desktop fallback for genuinely separate top-level modals. Keep same-modal success-text/confirmation matching, disappearance verification, background-error rejection, and fail-closed no-confirm behavior.

build_installer.ps1 packages the existing dist/POSReportBot/POSReportBot.exe and does not rebuild it. An installer filename and ProductVersion can say 2.1.25 while containing the old 2.1.24 EXE. For every release, run build_exe.ps1 before build_installer.ps1, then verify EXE FileVersion/ProductVersion, installer ProductVersion, hashes, signatures, and frozen dry-run. Reject and overwrite any installer whose contained executable provenance is stale.

The second 2026-08-14 W02 evidence refined the earlier diagnosis: after 23 committed items, the right gv_BrOrderItem grid exposed visible committed rows 15..22 and the exact 選取商品 header, while exposing no row-23 wrapper at all, even though the screenshot painted the trailing '*' insertion row at y=551..575. Therefore an exact-target-row geometry fallback cannot run and the failure deterministically lands on the 24th item; it is not item 6200006 or generic waiting. Preserve direct cell and exact-row lookup first. Only when the target row is absent, infer the next row inside exact gv_BrOrderItem from at least three consecutive, contiguous, equal-height committed rows that span the exact header x, and reject inference if the point exceeds the grid. Keep exact item-code, order-row code, quantity, prompt, save and ledger gates unchanged.

A regression that includes a visible exact target row only tests a virtualized cell, not the WinForms trailing-new-row failure seen in production. The faithful fixture must include the exact gv_BrOrderItem rectangle, exact 選取商品 header, three preceding committed row wrappers and no target row wrapper; it should first fail under the old algorithm, then assert the inferred center. Pair it with a negative case where row indexes are nonconsecutive so unsafe geometry cannot turn green.

Treating w02_item_added or item-picker OK as POS submission permanently deadlocks an unfinished W02 draft. The correct business and safety boundary is Save: completed/verified forms are skipped; failures before Save become retryable failed_before_save drafts and restart from item 1 after the existing order window is safely closed; immediately before clicking an already-resolved Save control, write ahead submitted_pending_verification/save_attempted so crashes or unverified prompts from that point remain blocked for manual review. Phase-less legacy in_progress entries remain ambiguous and blocked. A partial-state gate error itself must never mutate the legacy entry into a retryable state merely because the blocked attempt had no actions.

The exact partial-ledger bug is a two-run chain, not a single ledger parser branch. The tight test must make submit_plan run 1 append an item-added action and fail before Save, then invoke submit_plan again with the same plan and state directory; old behavior returns PARTIAL_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, while correct behavior calls the form submission again and completes. Pair it with a Save-prompt failure test asserting write-ahead submitted_pending_verification and a blocked second call.

A pywinauto click_input call on a background POS wrapper can return without exception even though the same screen coordinate actually hits the foreground POSReportBot Settings Center. The production signature is click:w02_open_branch_menu followed by no branch ComboBox candidates, while the failure screenshot shows Settings Center covering POS. Before W02 branch-menu physical input, restore/focus POS and require foreground ownership readback via the native HWND (GetForegroundWindow plus child/root ownership); if no HWND exists, require an explicit is_active readback. A no-op set_focus is not success evidence. Fail closed with W02_POS_WINDOW_FOCUS_FAILED and no click when ownership cannot be proved; invalidate cached wrappers after successful focus. Test both background-to-foreground success and set_focus-no-op rejection. Do not misdiagnose this shape as a branch alias or wait-duration problem.

Do not validate only FileVersion/ProductVersion StringStruct values. The 2.1.27 resource still had fixed filevers/prodvers=(2,1,24,0), and the test incorrectly preserved that stale tuple. On every release, assert package version, pyproject/template, Inno AppVersion, StringStruct FileVersion/ProductVersion and FixedFileInfo filevers/prodvers all match the same release. Build EXE before installer, then read back the generated EXE's native FileVersion/ProductVersion and hash before packaging it.

A branch-only focus fix merely moves a background click_input failure to the next physical step, as proven when N001 branch selection succeeded but the 常態訂貨 popup click was recorded while Chrome remained foreground. Guard every W02 click_input, double-click, geometry click and keyboard send at the common input boundary. Verify the exact target control's native root owns foreground, its process matches the original POS wrapper PID, and a top-level popup is owned by the POS root; walk parent wrappers when UIA items have no HWND. Reject unrelated same-process windows, external foreground targets and reused HWNDs. Bind geometry and keyboard fallbacks to their picker, prompt, combo or grid control instead of refocusing the POS root blindly.

Save is the non-idempotent W02 boundary. First prove the Save control's foreground ownership, then durably write submitted_pending_verification/save_attempted immediately before the first click attempt. If focus or write-ahead fails, do not click Save and keep the form retryable as failed_before_save. Once the first Save attempt starts, any wrapper exception is ambiguous because POS may already have accepted it; never fall back to click, invoke or geometry, preserve pending state and require POS review. A regression must model a click that performs its side effect and then raises, assert exactly one Save attempt, and assert the next run is blocked for review.

A W02 anti-duplicate ledger must never treat unreadable or semantically unknown state as empty. Validate JSON shape, schema version, run date, form entry type and the complete status enum; truncated JSON or a truncated status such as submitted_pending_verificatio must stop before any POS input. Write via same-directory temp, flush/fsync and an atomic durable replace (Windows MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH plus final flush; parent-directory fsync elsewhere). Roll back the in-memory save-attempt state if write-ahead persistence fails, and contain secondary failure-state/diagnostic write errors so submit_plan still returns a failed result rather than escaping or reporting success.

When a transient SPA-POS ComboBox already exposes a complete, bounded branch item list, forcing a geometry dropdown click first can collapse the popup during POS refocus and leave a stale HWND, producing W02_POS_WINDOW_FOCUS_FAILED even though N001-N006 were already readable. Select the exact materialized text programmatically once, invalidate cached wrappers, and verify via freshly rebound POS title/local controls. Once select or SelectedIndex is invoked, both return and exception are potentially dispatched mutations; if bounded fresh readback cannot prove the branch, fail closed with W02_POS_BRANCH_SELECTION_UNVERIFIED and never retry another alias/index or the stale physical dropdown. Keep physical fallback only for controls with no callable programmatic API.

Broad Desktop UIA descendants scans are a secondary W02 instability source: native logs can show COM 0x8001010d inside Desktop descendants, and a Python except cannot guarantee recovery from a native-layer failure. Search the connected POS local tree first for branch, account-menu, use-type and visible-option controls; scan Desktop only when local search is empty. Before programmatic mutation of any Desktop-derived control, require current control PID to equal the connected POS PID and prove parent/owner or native root-owner lineage. If both HWNDs exist, current Win32 PID/root-owner validation must take precedence over cached wrapper lineage so reused HWNDs and unrelated same-process windows are rejected.

A WinForms/UIA dispatch can mutate POS and then raise because the wrapper becomes stale. For branch text select, SelectedIndex, bounded keyboard, and visible-option invoke/select/click, treat every exception as ambiguous: first perform a fresh bounded readback; if the requested branch is already active, accept success without redispatch. If readback fails, abandon that wrapper immediately and let the caller reacquire; never try another method, keyboard, or physical click on the same wrapper. A no-op without exception may use the next bounded fallback only while target provenance and foreground ownership remain proven. Keep Save as a separate non-idempotent write-ahead boundary.

Rank native top-level POS HWNDs by visibility, configured title priority, and unique foreground provenance. In auto backend mode, exhaust UIA then win32 for the best HWND before trying any lower-ranked HWND; backend-first iteration can silently select a hidden stale session when only the best HWND has a transient UIA failure. Any Desktop fallback must apply the same ranking and fail closed when multiple candidates share the best rank without unique foreground evidence. Do not use process-wide UIA title or descendants scans for discovery on hosts that exhibit COM 0x8001010d.

Automatic failure evidence must be tied to the current execution rather than collected by recency scans. Include only the exact runtime journal, native crash file, active run-state, failure diagnostic/task evidence, and a bounded allow-listed reference graph. Enforce candidate/time/per-file limits and re-check the total against the redacted archive bytes because JSON pretty-printing can expand content. Reject symlinks, outside-root paths, configs, certificates, tokens and secret filenames; redact structured and text content plus the final manifest, including every path/path-list field. A denied sensitive path must leave neither its original filename nor a reversible or enumerable unsalted identifier. Exclude stale locked primary state even when referenced by the current journal.

When pywinauto ComboBoxWrapper.select raises the exact uia_defines.NoPatternInterfaceError stating there is no ExpandCollapsePattern/Open control, source inspection and production action evidence show the exception comes from expand() before selection dispatch. Do not classify this exact capability failure as an ambiguous stale mutation. After bounded fresh readback confirms the target is not already selected, skip the same unsupported select/index API and allow one bounded keyboard selection only if the control remains local/POS-owned, strictly visible, enabled, has valid geometry, and its foreground provenance is proven. Every other exception remains ambiguous: fresh readback first, then abandon the wrapper without redispatch.

A bounded-looking Desktop(backend='uia').windows call still performs global UIA find_elements/children work and can trigger fatal COM 0x8001010d before Python can recover. Discover transient W02 popup roots with Win32 EnumWindows, filter visible exact same-PID top-level HWNDs first, then connect each exact handle through UIA/win32 with per-root and total child budgets. The resulting wrapper must directly report the requested HWND; a missing handle or a parent/ancestor handle is not exact provenance. Windows ownerless mutation also requires a direct target HWND, live same PID and foreground-root proof. Strict liveness reads must fail closed when visibility, enabled state or rectangle is unreadable.

Removing descendants() is insufficient if prompt discovery recursively materializes every children() result or performs a second children() call after a bounded snapshot. Use one children-only snapshot with a shared depth/control budget, then classify prompt roots only from fields already available on those collected controls. A regression must use a prompt-title Text node with hundreds of children so the former post-snapshot title branch is exercised; ordinary node names create a false negative. Treat only true window/dialog/pane/custom prompt containers as scopes so Save/Confirm/Approve polling cannot rescan a large POS tree outside the budget.

A release can appear to be 2.1.31 while tests still assert CLI 2.1.30 and Windows FixedFileInfo filevers/prodvers remain 2.1.30. Version regression tests must derive one expected release and require package, CLI, pyproject/template, Inno AppVersion, StringStruct FileVersion/ProductVersion and fixed filevers/prodvers to match it. Read the built EXE FileVersion/ProductVersion, installer ProductVersion, hashes and Authenticode status after building EXE before installer; a stale expected tuple is a bug, not a compatibility requirement.

A 2.1.32 real run showed complete N001-N006 branch text and the exact NoPatternInterfaceError, but keyboard fallback was skipped because the ComboBox wrapper had no direct HWND and the A0042 ownerless popup had no usable owner chain. Same PID plus a target rectangle inside a small untitled foreground HWND is not sufficient: an unrelated same-PID transient window could overlap the stale target. For ownerless fallback, rebind the exact foreground HWND and accept only when its bounded UIA/win32 tree contains the target by automation id/type/rectangle or same-control identity; unknown surfaces must fail closed. Record the gate decision so the next evidence bundle identifies capability versus foreground-surface rejection directly.

The W02 repair is release-safe only when the ownerless-popup fallback performs exact foreground-HWND UIA/win32 rebind, bounded control-tree matching, strict visibility/enabled/rectangle checks, and emits gate telemetry; geometry or same-PID evidence alone must never authorize physical keyboard input. Version 2.1.33 was rebuilt unsigned after 874-test regression, W02 109/109, Ruff, mypy, diff-check, and independent no-findings review. Production completion remains pending one POS-host rerun because offline tests cannot validate SPA-POS behavior.

A 2.1.33 production run proved the branch ComboBox exposed a direct and resolved HWND while N001-N006 were fully readable, yet the keyboard gate remained false because the A0042 surface could not be proven as the foreground input owner. Once an exact live ComboBox HWND exists, foreground keyboard is the wrong dependency. Preflight the direct HWND for live/visible/enabled state, ComboBox class, exact POS PID, UIA/native rectangle agreement, and native index-to-text/alias agreement, then use Win32 ComboBoxWrapper.select(index), which sends CB_SETCURSEL and parent notifications without keyboard focus. Treat any exception after native select begins as a possibly dispatched mutation, require fresh branch readback, and never fall through to keyboard or another selection attempt.

When a visible-option summary already contains the requested branch, report selection failure instead of option-not-found; however plain substring matching is unsafe because N001 matches N0011 and PA matches PANEL. Reuse exact-token matching for ASCII branch codes and normalized containment only for non-ASCII names. Lock both directions with tests: exact N001/站前4樓 must classify as observed, while N0011/PANEL must not. This improves error truthfulness without changing POS mutation or ledger state.

Changing startup_ini_profile only changes what RPA will select the next time SPA-POS launches; it cannot switch an already logged-in POS process. A 2.1.34 W02 run selected the test ini, succeeded, and left its internally opened POS alive because W02 was classified as a local handler and its window never reached the outer pos_window cleanup variable. A later R01/R05 run configured for production connected that existing process without a new chooseini event, so correct dates/branches/options received real no-data warnings from the wrong environment. Track the actual last POS window regardless of handler category, close it at batch end, and never infer active environment from config or main-window title alone.

For test/production POS profiles, persist the verified ini profile together with both POS process ID and process creation time; PID alone is insufficient because Windows may reuse it. Reset the in-run selection attestation before every run and recovery, require the chooseini-time identity to match the currently connected POS identity before writing a marker, and fail unverified if a real PID exists but creation time cannot be established. Include configured profile, active profile and evidence kind in every report diagnostic; fail mismatch before opening reports. Clear the marker only after confirmed closure. Offline fakes may use an explicit no-identity compatibility path only when neither PID nor creation time exists.

A report runner may share a machine with more than one same-named POS process. Cleanup must target the process ID derived from the owned POS window; never fall back to taskkill /IM when a connected window has unknown identity or when per-PID termination fails. Keep the session marker and emit pos_close_unverified so the next run fails closed rather than killing unrelated POS instances or falsely declaring the environment closed.

The GUI columns 啟用 and 本次執行 are separate contracts: 啟用 controls scheduled/default planning, while a checked 本次執行 is an explicit one-run override that must not mutate or depend on the schedule flag. The 2.1.34 evidence began with output_count=2 and task_ids R01/R05 despite the user checking R06; the code reproducibly dropped a checked R06 twice when report.enabled was false—first in _selected_manual_task_ids and again in build_dry_run_plan. Preserve scheduled behavior when selected_task_ids is None, but let explicit selected IDs bypass only report.enabled; retain branch.enabled and W02's secondary safety gates. Log selected_task_ids, planned_task_ids and disabled_but_explicitly_selected_task_ids at run_started so future omissions are directly attributable.

A selected task ID does not prove an each_branch report produced outputs. The 2.1.36 runtime showed selected_task_ids R01/R05/R06, R06 report enabled, but planned_task_ids only R01/R05 because all configured branches were disabled. For an explicit one-run selection only, if every configured branch is disabled, expand all configured branches once without mutating persistent settings; scheduled planning remains empty, and partial branch disable settings remain authoritative. Log all_branches_disabled_but_explicitly_selected_task_ids so a selected-to-planned omission is directly attributable.

ClickOnce appref startup may show chooseini in a bootstrap process and, after an exact verified ini selection and confirm click, expose the final SPA-POS main window under a different PID. Requiring PID equality falsely rejects a legitimate fresh launch. Allow one handoff only when this runner requested the launch, request/current creation timestamps are parseable, and the final process was created no earlier than the launch request (small Windows clock tolerance); then bind attestation and marker to the final PID/creation time and consume the handoff. Reject pre-existing processes, another later PID, missing launch evidence, unreadable timestamps and PID reuse. Log both selection and final identities plus launch request time.

A GUI checkbox and selected_task_ids prove only that a report row exists. A legacy installed row can still retain handler=placeholder or an empty report_menu_text, so explicit manual selection bypasses enabled but _is_executable_report drops it before branch expansion. When current bundled defaults contain an executable contract for the same built-in ID, restore only missing/placeholder handler, menu text and menu path; preserve enabled, date, filename, upload and Drive settings, and never overwrite an already executable custom handler/menu. Log selected versus planned IDs so this is distinguishable from branch disablement.

On the real ClickOnce host, chooseini selection and final SPA-POS may keep the same PID while GetProcessTimes is transiently unavailable at selection. Do not reject solely because selection_process_created_at is null, but do not trust PID alone either. Permit one rebind only when selection and final PID are equal, the final creation time is readable, this runner issued the launch request, and final creation is no earlier than that request; reject a pre-existing process, unreadable final time or any later unrelated handoff.

Diagnostic collection and shutdown recovery are not exempt from UIA stability rules. The 2.1.37 native log captured RPC_E_CANTCALLOUT_ININPUTSYNCCALL 0x8001010d in desktop_window_snapshots and exit-confirmation Desktop(backend=uia).windows. Use Win32-only enumeration for global desktop metadata and exit-dialog fallback; UIA remains acceptable after a native HWND has already bounded the target POS window. Lock both paths with tests that fail if a global UIA Desktop is constructed.

When process creation time is the safety proof, validation and marker persistence must consume the same verified value. Re-querying GetProcessTimes while writing the marker creates a second transient-failure window: the first read can prove the fresh process and the second can still reject it. Pass the validated PID and creation timestamp into the recorder, and lock this with a test where only the first read succeeds.

Separating GUI 本次執行 from schedule enabled is incomplete if _should_include_report still applies weekly weekday matching. The production signature is selected_task_ids containing R06 while planned_task_ids omits it, with neither report-disabled nor all-branches-disabled telemetry. For every explicitly selected non-W02 report, bypass frequency/weekday for that one run without mutating persisted frequency; scheduled planning remains unchanged. Keep W02 next-run and anti-duplicate gates separate and authoritative.

Some SPA-POS processes keep GetProcessTimes unavailable from chooseini through the final main window. A safe operational fallback is narrower than a persistent PID marker: require this runner's recent launch request, exact ini verification, the same known PID at selection and current main window, no different-PID handoff, and a short bounded launch window; then keep the attestation in memory for this run only and write no persistent marker. A new runner or stale launch must fail closed. Runtime evidence must explicitly say run_scoped_only.

R06 member remaining-points residual reports are a daily RPA task. A Google Drive folder label containing 每週 is descriptive legacy naming and must not set or preserve report frequency. Normalize the built-in R06 frequency to daily when loading old configs, while preserving its dates, branches, output naming and Drive targets. Test a persisted weekly R06 migration explicitly so scheduled runs cannot silently remain weekly.

A valid non-empty uploaded workbook is not proof of the correct query scope. The 2026-09-03 scheduled R05 action log carried branch_mode=single: its product reference selected all branches, but after switching to the course form it performed no branch action and the screenshot showed HQ, producing a false NO_REPORT_DATA. R08 also carried single and exported without N001-N006 selection, creating a false success. Treat fixed built-in branch modes as execution contracts, normalize legacy YAML, lock the GUI control, and require action-log branch readback.

For required scheduled raw-data outputs, POS NO_REPORT_DATA means no file and no upload. Counting it as skipped while finishing the run with ok=true suppresses the configured failure notification and misleads downstream monitoring. Record every NO_REPORT_DATA as a task failure with its diagnostic path, keep later independent tasks running, and let the centralized final summary send the failure email. Special downstream zero-state markers may still exist, but they must not turn the source task into success.

Sending failure email only inside the normal output-summary builder misses early POS/connect/runner failures and sends before the automatic evidence bundle path is attached. Centralize notification at the outer run boundary after failure evidence finalization, emit started/finished/skipped telemetry, and avoid duplicate sends. A configured scheduled success-summary flag must have a real execution path that lists each output and Drive evidence; delivery failure must be visible in summary/run-state rather than swallowed.

Catching a COM exception is not the same as a stable run. The 2026-09-03 batch completed but its native crash log contained 37 RPC_E_CANTCALLOUT_ININPUTSYNCCALL 0x8001010d stacks, all from pywinauto UIA MenuWrapper.menu_select via _try_menu_select. When the connected SPA-POS window is UIA, bypass that native helper before dispatch and use the already-bounded visible root/leaf/popup route. Preserve win32 and offline mock compatibility and lock the no-dispatch rule with a focused regression test.

Disabling pywinauto UIA MenuWrapper.menu_select removed its COM crash but exposed that SPA-POS lower hidden statistics MenuItems can accept click_input without opening a form. In the 2.1.40 R08 run, three attempts logged clicks for 預約紀錄查詢統計表 yet every probe had active_form null and zero date inputs; 2.1.39 succeeded only through menu_select. For UIA statistics reports, verify the currently observed menu-name prefix/order, focus the root, send one bounded DOWN/index/ENTER sequence, and accept only the requested form plus two date inputs. Do not restore menu_select or trust a successful click call as activation proof.

Removing UIA menu_select is insufficient if the report-open polling loop still calls Desktop(backend=uia).windows every 0.5 seconds. The 2.1.40 R05/R08 native crash log contained 23 RPC_E_CANTCALLOUT_ININPUTSYNCCALL stacks, all from _dismiss_transient_pos_warning during _wait_for_report_screen_inputs.
